选词填空题和解析 · 26–35 题

本页 26–35 题的正确答案词与逐空解析由懒笔记按2026年6月·第1套 英语六级完形填空
（选词填空）原卷词库逐空核对整理。与试卷排版同一卷面：Directions、7 段带空短文
（每段之后紧随中文翻译）与 15 词共享词库连续排印；卷面下方逐空紧跟解析——该空
词性、原文定位句、正确词与锁定依据，以及同词性被淘汰竞争词的逐个归因。



真题卷第1套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part III Section A


Directions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for
each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through
carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the
corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not
use any of the words in the bank more than once.

   Two proposals are before the state legislature that look to put some limits on ever-increasing rent
prices, which some lawmakers say are contributing to rising homelessness rates.
州议会目前正在审议两项提案，旨在对不断上涨的租金设置一些限制。一些议员表示，租金上涨正在导致
无家可归率上升。

    The proposals       26       caps on rent increases, preventing landlords in the state from raising rent
more than the rate of inflation in most cases. There are exceptions for buildings less than 10 years old,
public housing, improvements beyond maintenance, and a hardship       27        .
这些提案对租金涨幅设定上限，在大多数情况下，禁止该州房东将租金涨幅提高到超过通货膨胀率的水
平。例外情况包括建成未满10年的建筑、公共住房、维护之外的改造，以及因困难而获得的豁免。

     In a 2020 study, researchers at the U.S. Government Accountability Office estimated that every $100
in rent increase is       28       to a 9% rise in homelessness. Rent increases have an even more detrimental
effect on some demographic groups, such as racial minorities.
在2020年的一项研究中，美国政府问责署的研究人员估计，租金每上涨100美元，就与无家可归率上升
9%相关。租金上涨对某些人口群体的影响更加不利，例如少数族裔。

     Representative Alex Ramel explained why he thought that this kind of legislation was so important,
telling the story of a       29       struggling to live in the community.
亚历克斯·拉梅尔议员讲述了一名努力在当地社区生活的选民的故事，并解释了他为何认为这类立法如此
重要。

Ramel pointed out  the       30       effect of  double-digit  rent  increases, saying  that he made  the
decision to introduce the legislation while talking to a young man in Bellingham. "He's a recent graduate
from Western Washington  University and  just  got  a new  job," Ramel  said. "He was  leaving  our
community because his landlord       31      him that his rent was going to go up by $600 a month."
拉梅尔指出，两位数租金涨幅会造成毁灭性影响。他说，自己是在与贝灵厄姆的一名年轻人交谈时决定提
出这项立法的。拉梅尔说：“他刚从西华盛顿大学毕业，最近找到了一份新工作。他正要离开我们的社
区，因为他的房东通知他，租金每月要上涨600美元。”

    The Rental Housing Association of Washington opposes the legislation. The association       32     
that the policy won't actually solve the problem of rental prices. Instead,  it will punish small landlords
and allow wealthy renters easy access to cheap housing.
华盛顿州租赁住房协会反对这项立法。该协会声称，这项政策实际上无法解决租金问题，反而会惩罚小房
东，让富裕租户轻易获得廉价住房。

    "The rent control policy has failed everywhere  it has been       33       in this county. It has not fixed
one housing problem       34        . It also does not distinguish between rich and poor when       35      who
gets the benefits of rent control," said Chester Baldwin with the Rental Housing Coalition.
租赁住房联盟的切斯特·鲍德温说：“租金管制政策在这个国家所有实施过的地方都失败了。它没有在任何
地方解决一个住房问题。在决定谁能从租金管制中受益时，它也不区分富人和穷人。”

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第1套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
26. The proposals __(26)__ caps on rent increases

【答案】J) impose 动词

【词性槽】复数主语 proposals 之后缺谓语，需动词原形（一般现在时）

【依据】impose caps/limits on 是政策语域的固定搭配，「对……设限」

       The proposals __(26)__ caps on rent increases, preventing landlords in the state from
         raising rent more than the rate of inflation in most cases.——提案「对租金涨幅设上
    限」，呼应首段 put some limits on ever-increasing rent prices，impose caps on 与
        put limits on 是同义改写，这正是六级最爱考的「换说法不换意思」。

【竞争词】M) presume presume 意为「假定」，与 caps 不构成搭配且逻辑相反

          presume 是「假定、推测」，presume caps 不是英语搭配；且提案是「实际设限」而非「假定
      存在上限」，代入后与后半句 preventing landlords…（实际阻止房东涨租）矛盾。

【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 M) —— presume 与 impose 同为原形动词，「提案假定上限」粗
     读似乎也通。The proposals __(26)__ caps on rent increases 中 presume 形态合格，且
    考生若只认识 presume 不认识 impose，容易用「熟悉的词」填。防坑：盯住宾语搭配
        ——caps/limits 的舞伴是 impose（impose caps on），presume 后接的是「事实从
    句」；再回看首段 put some limits on ever-increasing rent prices，同义改写的锚点直接
    指向 impose。

     27. There are exceptions for buildings less than 10 years old, public housing, improvements beyond
maintenance, and a hardship __(27)__.

【答案】I) exemption 名词

【词性槽】不定冠词 a + 名词作定语的 hardship 之后，需单数可数名词

【依据】hardship exemption「困难豁免」是政策文本的固定说法，且与 exceptions 同义呼应

        There are exceptions for buildings less than 10 years old, public housing,
       improvements beyond maintenance, and a hardship __(27)__.——列举的都是「不适用
    该限制的豁免情形」，a hardship exemption（因困难而获得的豁免）与句首 exceptions
    同义复现，政策语域用词精准。

【竞争词】C) constituent constituent「选民」不能与 hardship 构成政策豁免概念

          a hardship constituent 字面上是「一位困难的选民」，但本句列举的是例外「情形/类别」
      （建筑、公屋、改良工程），不是人；且选民不属于租金管制条例的豁免条款范畴，语义场
      不合。

          N) rehabilitation rehabilitation 意为「康复/修复」，与 hardship 搭配不成立

           hardship rehabilitation（困难修复）不是英语里的政策术语；rehabilitation 多指罪犯改造、
      病人康复或建筑翻修，与「豁免条款」的语境无关。





               懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/cet6/sections/2026-06-1/part3-section-a/?f=p · 在线使用效果更好

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第1套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
28. every $100 in rent increase is __(28)__ to a 9% rise in homelessness

【答案】D) correlated 动词

【词性槽】be 动词 is 之后、介词 to 之前，需过去分词构成 be done 表语结构

【依据】be correlated to 是固定搭配，意为「与……相关」，严丝合缝

    研究语境 researchers at the U.S. Government Accountability Office estimated that
        every $100 in rent increase is __(28)__ to a 9% rise in homelessness：租金每涨 100 美
    元「对应/关联」无家可归率上升 9%——这正是相关性表述，be correlated to/with 是六
    级阅读与选词填空的高频固定搭配，语义与搭配双契合。

【竞争词】G) enacted enact 的搭配对象是法律而非数据关系

          enacted 意为「颁布（法律）」，其主语应是立法机构、宾语是法案；「租金上涨被颁布成无家
      可归率上升 9%」语义不通，且 enact 不与 to 构成表语搭配。

          K) notified notify 的对象必须是人

            notify sb of/that… 意为「通知某人」，被通知方是人；这里主语是 every $100 in rent
      increase（物），「租金上涨被通知给无家可归率」不成立，也不与 to 搭配。

     29. telling the story of a __(29)__ struggling to live in the community

【答案】C) constituent 名词

【词性槽】不定冠词 a 之后、分词短语 struggling… 之前，需单数可数名词指人

【依据】议员讲「选民」的艰难故事，身份与语境严丝合缝

        Representative Alex Ramel explained why he thought that this kind of legislation
       was so important, telling the story of a __(29)__ struggling to live in the community.
    ——说话者是 Representative（众议员），议员为自己的立法辩护时讲的是「选区选民」
       的故事；constituent 正是「（选区的）选民」，且下一段 he made the decision to
        introduce the legislation while talking to a young man in Bellingham 的 a young
      man 就是这个 constituent 的具体化。

【竞争词】N) rehabilitation rehabilitation 是抽象事物名词，不能「挣扎着生活」

        rehabilitation（康复/修复）是物不是人，无法充当 struggling to live 的逻辑主语；「一个挣
      扎着住在社区里的康复」语义荒谬，直接排除。





               懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/cet6/sections/2026-06-1/part3-section-a/?f=p · 在线使用效果更好

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第1套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
30. Ramel pointed out the __(30)__ effect of double-digit rent increases

【答案】F) devastating 形容词

【词性槽】定冠词 the 与名词 effect 之间，需形容词作定语

【依据】devastating effect 是高频搭配，且与「两位数涨幅」的负面语境吻合

    上下文 Ramel pointed out the __(30)__ effect of double-digit rent increases 与 Rent
         increases have an even more detrimental effect on some demographic groups 呼
     应：说话者是立法支持者，强调租金暴涨的「毁灭性」影响，devastating effect（毁灭性
    的影响）搭配与感情色彩双双贴合。

【竞争词】C) constituent constituent 作形容词意为「组成的」，与 effect 不搭

            constituent 虽有形容词用法（组成的、构成整体的），但 constituent effect 不是英语搭配；
      其名词义「选民」也与本空语法槽（名词前的定语形容词）语义不合。

     31. his landlord __(31)__ him that his rent was going to go up by $600 a month

【答案】K) notified 动词

【词性槽】his landlord 后缺谓语，且后接双宾 him + that 从句，需及物动词过去式

【依据】notify sb that… 「通知某人……」，房东通知涨租正是此场景

      He was leaving our community because his landlord __(31)__ him that his rent was
        going to go up by $600 a month.——他要搬离，因为房东「通知」他月租要涨 600 美
       元。notify sb that 从句句型严丝合缝，因果链（被通知涨租 → 被迫搬走）完全通顺。

     32. The association __(32)__ that the policy won't actually solve the problem of rental prices.

【答案】B) asserts 动词

【词性槽】单数主语 The association 后缺谓语，需三单动词接 that 从句

【依据】assert that… 「坚称」，正是机构表态反对的措辞

       The Rental Housing Association of Washington opposes the legislation. The
         association __(32)__ that the policy won't actually solve the problem of rental prices.
     ——协会反对立法，「坚称」该政策解决不了租金问题。assert 接 that 从句表强硬主张，
    与前句 opposes 的反对立场无缝衔接。

【竞争词】H) entails entail 是及物动词接名词性成分，不接 that 从句

             entails 意为「使必要、涉及」，用法是 A entails B（B 为名词/动名词），如 The job entails
         travel；它没有 entail that 从句表「声称」的用法，代入后句法不成立。

【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 H) —— entails 与 asserts 同为三单，形态零区分度，最易凭模糊
     词义选错。The association __(32)__ that the policy won't actually solve the problem
         of rental prices. 中 entails 词性、时态全部合格，「涉及问题」的字面意思又和语境沾边，
    是最强干扰。防坑口诀：空后是 that 从句时先问动词能不能带宾语从句——entail 只能接
      名词性宾语，assert 才能接 that 从句表「坚称」，句法门槛一过见分晓。





               懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/cet6/sections/2026-06-1/part3-section-a/?f=p · 在线使用效果更好

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第1套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
33. The rent control policy has failed everywhere it has been __(33)__ in this county.

【答案】G) enacted 动词

【词性槽】has been 之后需过去分词，构成现在完成被动语态

【依据】法律政策「被颁布实施」用 enact，法案语域的专属动词

       The rent control policy has failed everywhere it has been __(33)__ in this county.——
     租金管控政策「凡是在本县被实施过的地方都失败了」。enact 专用于「颁布法律、实施
    政策」，与 policy 构成最自然的被动搭配，也是说话者（反对派）论证政策无效的语义
    所需。

【竞争词】K) notified notify 的对象是人，政策不能被「通知」

            notified 意为「被通知」，其逻辑主语必须是人（sb be notified of/that…）；it 指 policy
      （物），「政策被通知」语义不通。

     34. It has not fixed one housing problem __(34)__.

【答案】A) anywhere 副词

【词性槽】句子主干完整（It has not fixed one housing problem），空在句尾作状语，需副词

【依据】否定句 + anywhere = 「在任何地方都不」，承接上句 everywhere

       The rent control policy has failed everywhere it has been __(33)__ in this county. It
        has not fixed one housing problem __(34)__.——上句说政策「处处失败」，本句递进
     「它在任何地方都没能解决哪怕一个住房问题」。not…anywhere 是英语否定的标准搭配，
    与 everywhere 形成语义对仗，语气一气呵成。

【竞争词】L) notwithstanding notwithstanding 表让步「尽管如此」，与本句递进逻辑冲突

           notwithstanding 作副词意为「尽管如此」（表让步转折），而本句与上句是递进强调（处处失
      败 → 一个问题都没解决），不是让步；且 notwithstanding 通常不单独置于句尾修饰否定陈述
      句，代入后逻辑和句法双不通。





               懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/cet6/sections/2026-06-1/part3-section-a/?f=p · 在线使用效果更好

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第1套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
35. It also does not distinguish between rich and poor when __(35)__ who gets the benefits of
rent control

【词性槽】when 引导的省略状语从句 when (it is) doing，需现在分词

【依据】determine who gets the benefits「决定谁受益」，与 distinguish 的批评逻辑一致

             It also does not distinguish between rich and poor when __(35)__ who gets the
         benefits of rent control——批评者说该政策「在决定谁享受租金管控的好处时不区分贫
       富」。determine + 宾语从句（决定……）搭配自然，且与前文 it will punish small
         landlords and allow wealthy renters easy access to cheap housing 的批评（富人也能
    占便宜）完全同向。

【竞争词】O) reproaching reproach 意为「责备」，其对象是人且与 who gets… 从句不搭

D I S T R A C T O R S · 干扰词复盘

这 5 个词始终没被任何空选用

词库 15 词里有 5 个是命题人埋的干扰词——它们词性看着也对、词义也沾点边，却不该
填进任何一个空。下面逐个剖析它们最像哪个空的答案、为什么是陷阱。




   H) entails 最像 32 空的答案：同为三单动词，词义「涉及」看着也沾边

   32 空 The association __(32)__ that the policy won't actually solve the problem of rental prices. 需
  要三单动词，entails 形态完全合格，且「政策涉及问题」的字面意思容易误导。识破点：entail 是
  「A entails B（名词性成分）」的及物动词，不能接 that 宾语从句表「声称」；机构表态反对只可
  能是 assert/claim 类言论动词。



   L) notwithstanding 最像 34 空的答案：同为副词，且是书面语高频词看着「高级」

   34 空 It has not fixed one housing problem __(34)__. 是句尾副词槽，notwithstanding 是词库仅有
  的另一个副词，且常见于正式文本，容易凭「眼熟」误选。识破点：notwithstanding 表让步（尽
  管如此），而上下句是递进强调（failed everywhere → not fixed anywhere），逻辑关系不匹配；
  另外 not…anywhere 是否定句的标配。



   M) presume 最像 26 空的答案：同为动词原形，词形与 impose 一样符合语法槽

   26 空 The proposals __(26)__ caps on rent increases 需动词原形，presume 形态合格，粗心的考生
  看到「提案 + 上限」会觉得「假定上限」也通。识破点：presume 的宾语是「某个命题/事实」，
  不与 caps 搭配；且后文 preventing landlords… 说明上限是被实际推行的，impose caps on（对……
  设限）才是政策语域的固定说法。



   N) rehabilitation 最像 27 空的答案：同为名词，且与住房话题隐隐沾边（房屋修缮）

   27 空 a hardship __(27)__ 在名词候选里，rehabilitation 可指「建筑翻修」，与全文住房主题有话题
  相关性，容易被「眼熟的话题词」勾走。识破点：本句列举的是 exceptions（豁免情形），a
   hardship ___ 必须与 exceptions 同义，只有 exemption（豁免）对得上； rehabilitation 与「豁免」
  语义无关，也不与 hardship 构成搭配。

  Two proposals are before the state legislature that look to put some limits on ever-

  “主句主语 + 状语 + 后置定语从句”的分隔修饰结构以及“关系词 + 插入语 + 谓语”的句式在四六级

真题卷第1套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part III Section B


Directions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to  it. Each
statement contains information given in one of the paragraphs. Identify the paragraph from which the
information is derived. You may choose a paragraph more than once. Each paragraph is marked with a
letter. Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.

            Meet the "digital nomads" who travel the world in search of fast Wi-Fi

A) For those "citizens of the world", the office can be anything from a beach hut in Brisbane to a
    Starbucks in Seattle, thanks to the growing prevalence of remote-based work. But roaming the globe
   from café to café is not without its challenges.
  对于那些“世界公民”来说，得益于远程办公日益普及，办公室可以是从布里斯班的一间海滩小屋到西
  雅图的一家星巴克之间的任何地方。但从一家咖啡馆游荡到另一家、周游世界，也并非没有挑战。

B) When the average traveller lands in a city like Bangkok, Berlin, or Buenos Aires,  their  first step
   might be to drop their bags at their hotel and to log on to TripAdvisor to find out the hours of a
    popular tourist attraction or the best rooftop bar for happy hour.
  当普通旅行者抵达曼谷、柏林或布宜诺斯艾利斯这样的城市时，他们第一步可能是把行李放在酒店，
  然后登录TripAdvisor，了解热门旅游景点的开放时间，或寻找一家适合欢乐时光的最佳屋顶酒吧。

C) But people like Pieter Levels are not your average traveller. A Dutch website developer, Levels has
   been living and working nomadically(像游牧民那样) in places like Singapore, Hong Kong, Tokyo
   and Manila for two years. With just a carry-on backpack, he chooses his location at will, based on a
    variety of factors—Wi-Fi speed, average temperature, exotic food and cost of living—that have  little
    bearing on the work he actually does.
   但像Pieter Levels这样的人并不是普通旅行者。Levels是一名荷兰网站开发者，过去两年一直像游牧
  民一样生活和工作，辗转于新加坡、香港、东京和马尼拉等地。他只带一个登机背包，可以随心选择

text:
地点，依据的是各种因素——无线网络速度、平均气温、异国美食和生活成本——而这些因素与他实
  际从事的工作关系不大。

D) Somewhere in his nomadic journey, Levels noticed that there was a growing need to create an online
    infrastructure  for people  like himself. That's when he created #nomads, a membership-based chat
   system which runs on the team communication platform known as Slack. The channel allows users
    to ask people in their current city the types of practical questions that a tourist would unlikely need
    to ask.
  在游牧旅程中的某个时候，Levels注意到，像他这样的人越来越需要建立一个在线基础设施。于是，
  他创建了#nomads，这是一个基于会员制的聊天系统，运行于名为Slack的团队沟通平台之上。这个
  频道允许用户向身处他们当前所在城市的人询问一些游客通常不太可能需要询问的实际问题。

E) Members of the geographically dispersed subculture that Levels is a part of call themselves "digital
   nomads". They are borderless, mostly self-employed remote workers who interact with cities in a way
    that's entirely different from a tourist, but  still doesn't quite reach the status of resident. A relatively
   new phenomenon,  there  are no  hard  statistics on  the  prevalence  of  digital nomads  or  location
   independent workers. But thanks to the growing prevalence of freelance(自由职业的) livelihoods, a
    global sharing economy and numerous digital tools, the number of people who are able to live this
     life is growing quickly. And in a rapidly urbanising world, where a major city in Asia increasingly
    offers the same comforts as one in Europe, many people are reaching the realisation they don't need
    to stay in one place.
  Levels所属的这一地理上分散的亚文化群体称自己为“数字游民”。他们不受国界限制，大多是自雇的远
  程工作者；他们与城市互动的方式与游客完全不同，却又没有完全达到居民的身份。这是一个相对较
  新的现象，目前没有关于数字游民或不受地点限制的工作者普及程度的确切统计数据。但得益于自由
  职业生计的日益普及、全球共享经济以及众多数字工具，能够过上这种生活的人数正在迅速增加。在
  一个快速城市化的世界里，亚洲的一座大城市越来越能提供与欧洲城市相同的舒适条件，许多人开始
  意识到，他们不必一直待在同一个地方。

F) So how does a nomad differ from a tourist or resident? In many ways, Levels says, you can think of
   a digital nomad like a "short-term independent expat(移居国外的人)". Unlike a resident expat, they
    don't work for a large multinational company in an air conditioned office building and they generally
    enter a country on a tourist visa, simply renewing or moving on when it expires. But unlike a tourist,
   they don't arrive in a foreign city without any responsibilities. Travel  isn't necessarily required for
   them to do their jobs, but neither is staying in one place.
  那么，游民与游客或居民有何不同？Levels说，在许多方面，你可以把数字游民看作“短期独立外籍人
  士”。与居住在当地的外籍人士不同，他们不会在大型跨国公司的空调办公楼里工作，通常会持旅游签
  证进入一个国家，签证到期后简单地续签或继续前往下一处。但他们又不同于游客，因为他们抵达外
  国城市时并不是毫无责任。旅行并非他们完成工作所必需，但留在同一个地方也同样不是必需的。

G) Janet Brent is an independent ebook designer. She says many people she knows assume she travels
    for work, but  in  reality her  international  destinations are  largely up  to  her, and driven by  cost.
    "Contrary to what some people might think, I don't get paid to travel—I simply choose the lifestyle.
    Rather than rent in one given city, I choose to travel and do short-term, temporary stays around the

the same comforts as one in Europe, many people are reaching the realisation they

So how does a nomad differ from a tourist or resident?

   information online about its popular tourist attractions.

  第40题题干

   "The first/only thing... is to do..." 是真题阅读与写作中高度高频出现的典型句式，掌握后可直接迁
  移用于长难句分析与写作表达。



   Pieter Levels says his life as a nomad has transformed not only his idea of
   citizenship, but his choice of companions.

  第44题题干

  “主句动词 + 省略 that 的宾语从句”以及 "not only ... but ..." 并列结构均为英语考试中极为常见且通
  用的高频句式。



   Interactions with local people and institutions provide nomads with far more
   cultural information than a visit to the national museum.

  第45题题干

  采用了典型的'抽象名词+介词短语作主语 + provide sb with sth + 比较结构'模式，在四六级与考研
  阅读中出现频率高。

真题卷第1套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part III Section C


Directions: There  are 2 passages  in  this  section. Each passage  is  followed by some  questions or
unfinished statements. For each of them there are four choices marked A)  , B)  , C) and D)  . You should
decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding  letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single  line
through the centre.

Passage One
Questions 46 to 50 are based on the following passage.

    P1  Children's use of social media  is a problem. That doesn't mean  it should be stopped. While
younger children should not be on platforms where 13  is the minimum age,  it  is neither practical nor
desirable  to  imagine  a  world  in which  teenagers  are  prevented from  accessing  the  platforms and
messaging systems that the adults around them use to organise their lives.
儿童使用社交媒体是一个问题。但这并不意味着应当制止这种行为。年幼的儿童不应使用最低年龄限制为
13岁的社交平台，但设想这样一个世界既不现实，也不可取：青少年无法访问身边成年人用来安排生活的
各种平台和消息系统。

    P2 But the pleasure and stimulation that people of  all ages find on their screens and smartphones
must not blind us to the harm that spending time in this way can cause. The finding that the alarmingly
high rate of depression in British teenage  girls  is closely correlated to time spent on social media  is
extremely concerning. Research found that two in five girls are on social media for at least three hours a
day—with half as many boys engaged to the same extent. More than a third of depressed  girls have
experienced online harassment. About half of affected girls suffered disrupted sleep, compared with 20%
of depressed boys.
不过，各个年龄段的人从屏幕和智能手机中获得的愉悦与刺激，不应使我们忽视以这种方式消磨时间可能
造成的伤害。英国少女抑郁症发病率高得令人担忧，而这一现象与花在社交媒体上的时间密切相关，这一
发现极其令人忧虑。研究发现，五分之二的女孩每天使用社交媒体至少三个小时，而达到同等程度的男孩

text:
只有这一比例的一半。超过三分之一的抑郁女孩曾遭受网络骚扰。受到影响的女孩中，约有一半睡眠受到
干扰，而抑郁男孩中这一比例为20%。

    P3 Although the research does not prove that social media causes depression, the importance of the
finding that there  is a connection should not be underestimated. Schools have done important work in
communicating key messages about the risks of online abuse. But when  it comes to broader questions
about "screen time", many professionals as well as parents are confused and uncertain.
尽管这项研究并未证明社交媒体会导致抑郁，但不能低估“二者存在关联”这一发现的重要性。学校在传达
有关网络虐待风险的重要信息方面已经开展了重要工作。但是，在涉及有关“屏幕时间”的更广泛问题时，
许多专业人士和家长一样，都感到困惑和不确定。

    P4 The health secretary, Matt Hancock, wants official guidelines on time and age limits. This idea
has the virtue of simplicity, though some experts question  its effects and  call for a greater degree of
differentiation, arguing that time online by itself is not a bad thing and  it all depends on what you are
doing. Also due this year is information commissioner Elizabeth Denham's Age Appropriate Design Code,
covering the use of children's personal data. Both initiatives are welcome. But the government is playing
catch-up. Statutory regulation of the digital media giants is long overdue. The failure to protect children
from data harvesting and targeted advertising thus far  is as shocking as the lack of concern shown by
the companies themselves with regard to children's psychological health.
卫生大臣马特·汉考克希望制定关于使用时间和年龄限制的官方指导方针。这一想法的优点在于简单明了，
尽管一些专家质疑其效果，并呼吁进行更大程度的区分，认为上网本身并不是坏事，关键在于你在网上做
什么。此外，信息专员伊丽莎白·德纳姆制定的《适龄设计规范》也将于今年出台，内容涉及儿童个人数据
的使用。这两项举措都值得欢迎。但政府一直在追赶。对数字媒体巨头进行法定监管早就应当实施。迄今
为止未能保护儿童免受数据收集和定向广告侵害，这一点令人震惊，正如相关企业本身对儿童心理健康表
现出的漠不关心同样令人震惊。

    P5 Of course, social media companies are not the source of  all our  ills, and can offer a too-easy
target for politicians keen to divert attention from inadequately resourced schools and health services.
There are other reasons for the rising incidence of depression in young people, with increasing pressure
to succeed in education and in life more broadly—to be famous, beautiful, rich—often cited as a source
of unhappiness or anxiety which can, if aggravated by other factors and not managed, tip into  ill health.
Safeguarding means more than the avoidance of physical threat.
当然，社交媒体公司并不是我们所有问题的根源，也可能成为那些急于转移公众对资源不足的学校和医疗
服务关注的政客们一个过于容易的目标。年轻人抑郁症发病率上升还有其他原因。人们常常认为，日益增
加的教育压力以及在更广泛的生活中取得成功的压力——成为名人、美丽而富有——是不快乐或焦虑的
来源；如果这些情绪受到其他因素加剧且没有得到妥善处理，就可能恶化为健康问题。保护儿童意味着不
仅要避免身体上的威胁。

46. What does the author believe regarding social media?

   A) To stop children using it is unrealistic and inadvisable.

   B) It helps both adults and children to organise their lives.

   C) It poses problems to both parents and children.

   D) A world without it is really hard to imagine.

作者认为社交媒体怎么样？

A) 阻止孩子使用社交媒体既不现实，也不可取。  B) 社交媒体有助于成年人和孩子安排自己的生活。

C) 社交媒体给父母和孩子都带来了问题。  D) 确实很难想象一个没有社交媒体的世界。
【答案】A （细节题）

【判型】题干 What does the author believe regarding social media? 问的是作者对一个明确话
    题的具体判断，有确定对象可回文查找，属于观点类细节题。

【拆句】Q46 是 What 引导的简单疑问句，regarding social media 是介词短语限定话题范围，无
    否定、无比较、无长修饰，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】While younger children should not be on platforms where 13 is the minimum age, it is neither
          practical nor desirable to imagine a world in which teenagers are prevented from accessing
          the platforms and messaging systems that the adults around them use to organise their lives.

    虽然更年幼的儿童不该使用最低年龄为13岁的平台，但想象一个青少年被禁止使用周遭成年
    人用来安排生活的平台和通讯系统的世界，既不现实也不可取。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确
               neither practical nor desirable ↔unrealistic and inadvisable
              teenagers are prevented from accessing the platforms ↔To stop children using it
      预判'禁止孩子使用不现实也不明智'与 To stop children using it is unrealistic and
             inadvisable. 的行为、评价两层完全对应，锁定 A。

        B) 偷换概念
      原文只说平台是 the adults around them use to organise their lives——用来安排生
      活的是成年人，并未说社交媒体帮助儿童安排生活；It helps both adults and children
            to organise their lives. 把用途主体扩大成'成年人和儿童双方'。

        C) 偷换概念
      原文是 Children's use of social media is a problem.——'儿童使用社交媒体是个问
       题'，问题的承载者是儿童的使用行为；It poses problems to both parents and
             children. 改写成'给父母和孩子双方都带来问题'，parents 一方原文从未提及。

        D) 偷换概念
      原文 it is neither practical nor desirable to imagine a world 是评价'这种世界不现实
      也不可取'，不是说这个世界难以想象；A world without it is really hard to imagine.
      把价值判断偷换成认知难度判断，且暗含'没有它的世界无法想象'，与作者'年幼儿童本就
      不该用'的前提相悖。

47. What do we learn from the passage about British teenage girls?

   A) The more frequently they interact on social media, the more they experience harassment.

   B) The more time they spend on social media, the more likely they suffer from depression.

   C) Most of them are engaged on social media for at least three hours a day.

   D) They spend half as many hours on social media as British teenage boys.

从文章中我们了解到英国十几岁的女孩什么情况？

A) 她们在社交媒体上的互动越频繁，遭受骚扰的情况就越多。

B) 她们花在社交媒体上的时间越多，患抑郁症的可能性就越大。

C) 她们中的大多数每天至少花三个小时使用社交媒体。

D) 她们花在社交媒体上的时间是英国十几岁男孩的一半。
【答案】B （细节题）

【判型】What do we learn from the passage about British teenage girls? 是典型的文中事实提
    问，要求找出关于该群体的哪个说法与原文相符。

【拆句】Q47 主干 What do we learn，from the passage 与 about British teenage girls 两个介
    词短语分别限定来源与对象，无语法陷阱；注意四个备选都是 the more...the more 或数量
    比较的说法，真正的难点在选项侧的比较关系。

【定位】The finding that the alarmingly high rate of depression in British teenage girls is closely
          correlated to time spent on social media is extremely concerning.

    英国少女抑郁症比例高得惊人、且与花在社交媒体上的时间密切相关，这一发现极其令人
    担忧。

【选项】A) 过度推断
      原文只说 More than a third of depressed girls have experienced online
       harassment.——抑郁女孩中超过三分之一遭遇过网络骚扰，这是一个静态比例；The
         more frequently they interact on social media, the more they experience
           harassment. 把它升级成'互动越频繁骚扰越多'的递增关系，原文没有任何依据。

        B) ✓ 正确
                  is closely correlated to time spent on social media ↔

           The more time they spend on social media, the more likely they suffer from depression
              the alarmingly high rate of depression in British teenage girls ↔they suffer from depression

       预判'时间越多越可能抑郁'与 The more time they spend on social media, the more
               likely they suffer from depression. 完全同向同义；其余三项都在数据的主语或比例上
      动了手脚，锁定 B。

        C) 偷换概念
      原文是 two in five girls are on social media for at least three hours a day——五分
       之二（40%）是少数；Most of them are engaged on social media for at least
            three hours a day. 用 Most（大多数，>50%）替换，数量范围被明显夸大。

        D) 与原文相反
      原文 with half as many boys engaged to the same extent 说的是：达到同等使用
      强度的男生人数是女生的一半；They spend half as many hours on social media as
              British teenage boys. 反说成'女生花的时间是男生的一半'，比较的主体与方向全部
      颠倒。


48. What is the author's view on the research finding about British teenage girls?

   A) Its implications about online abuse are obvious.

   B) Its key message calls for immediate attention.

   C) Its importance should not be undervalued.

   D) Its uncertainty should not go unnoticed.

作者如何看待关于英国十几岁女孩的研究结果？

A) 该结果关于网络虐待的含义显而易见。  B) 该结果传达的关键信息需要立即得到重视。

C) 不应低估该结果的重要性。  D) 不应忽视该结果的不确定性。
【答案】C （细节题）

【判型】What is the author's view on the research finding about British teenage girls? 问的是
    对一个明确对象（研究发现）的看法，该对象在文中有确定位置，属于观点类细节题而非全
    文态度题。

【拆句】Q48 主干 What is the author's view，on the research finding 限定评价对象，about
          British teenage girls 进一步限定是哪一项发现。两层介词短语嵌套，读题时注意评价对象
    是 finding 而不是 girls 本身。

text:
【定位】Although the research does not prove that social media causes depression, the importance of
          the finding that there is a connection should not be underestimated.

    尽管这项研究并未证明社交媒体导致抑郁，但'两者存在关联'这一发现的重要性不应被
    低估。

【选项】A) 无中生有
      原文说 Schools have done important work in communicating key messages
          about the risks of online abuse.——传达网络虐待风险是学校的已有工作；Its
            implications about online abuse are obvious. 声称该发现对网络虐待的'启示显而易
          见'，obvious 在原文无任何对应，且与后文 many professionals as well as parents
            are confused and uncertain 的'困惑不确定'相抵触。

        B) 过度推断
       作者的评价止步于'重要性不应被低估'；Its key message calls for immediate
             attention. 进一步主张'需要立即关注/行动'，immediate 这层紧迫性是选项自行加码
      ——第二段的 is extremely concerning 虽令人担忧，但也不等于'要求立即处置'。

        C) ✓ 正确
              the importance of the finding that there is a connection should not be underestimated ↔

                Its importance should not be undervalued.
       预判'重要性不应被低估'与 Its importance should not be undervalued. 仅一词之差
        （underestimated→undervalued），是本卷最直白的一组同义替换，锁定 C。

        D) 与原文相反
                Its uncertainty should not go unnoticed. 揪住'不确定性'不放，但这正是 Although
      从句 the research does not prove that social media causes depression 里作者主动
      让步、并用主句压过去的内容；作者强调的是重要性，不是提醒人们注意不确定性，选
      项与作者着力的方向相反。


49. What do experts think of health secretary Matt Hancock's idea?

   A) Its implementation requires prompt action.

   B) It is a welcome initiative but is long overdue.

   C) Its success depends on how it is implemented.

   D) It is too simplistic to produce the desired effect.

专家如何看待卫生大臣 Matt Hancock 的想法？
A) 其实施需要迅速采取行动。  B) 这是一项值得欢迎的倡议，但早就应该提出了。

C) 其成败取决于实施方式。  D) 这一想法过于简单化，无法产生预期效果。
【答案】D （细节题）

【判型】What do experts think of health secretary Matt Hancock's idea? 主体（experts）与对
       象（Hancock's idea）都明确可定位，是观点类细节题；只是正确项需要把原文两处评价整

【定位】This idea has the virtue of simplicity, though some experts question its effects and call for a

    这个想法有简单这一优点，不过一些专家质疑其效果，并主张更大程度的区别对待，理由是
    上网时间本身并非坏事，关键在于你在做什么。

【选项】A) 无中生有
                Its implementation requires prompt action. 称实施需要迅速行动，但专家对效果的
        质疑与'快慢'无关，prompt action 在原文没有任何对应表述，属于凭空添加的主张。

        B) 张冠李戴
                  It is a welcome initiative but is long overdue. 里，welcome 出自作者对两项举措的
      总评 Both initiatives are welcome.，long overdue 出自作者对监管巨头滞后的批评
            Statutory regulation of the digital media giants is long overdue.——两句都是作者
      的声音，且 overdue 说的还不是这个想法本身；题干问的是专家。

        C) 偷换概念
      原文专家说 it all depends on what you are doing——效果取决于你在网上做什么
        （内容），Its success depends on how it is implemented. 偷换成'取决于如何实
         施'；depends on 句型原样照搬，宾语却被整个换掉。

        D) ✓ 正确
             has the virtue of simplicity ↔too simplistic
           some experts question its effects ↔to produce the desired effect

       预判'太简单、难奏效'正是 It is too simplistic to produce the desired effect. 的字面
       意思，且每一半都能在定位句找到出处（simplicity / question its effects），锁定 D。


50. Besides social media companies, what factors contribute to young people's psychological health
   problems?

   A) Poorly financed schools and health services.

   B) Politicians' eagerness to divert public attention.

   C) Bad statutory regulation of digital media giants.

   D) Their parents' educational background and life.

除了社交媒体公司之外，还有哪些因素导致年轻人的心理健康问题？

A) 资金不足的学校和医疗服务。  B) 政客们急于转移公众注意力。

C) 对数字媒体巨头不完善的法定监管。  D) 他们父母的教育背景和生活状况。
【答案】A （细节题）

text:
【判型】Besides social media companies, what factors contribute to young people's
         psychological health problems? 问文中列举了哪些其他成因，有明确的列举句可查，属
    细节题。

【拆句】Q50 主干 what factors contribute to young people's psychological health
      problems，句首 Besides social media companies 是介词短语作排除限定。contribute
         to 表示'促成'，问的是成因；Besides 是全题题眼，决定答案不能落在社交媒体公司头上。

【定位】Of course, social media companies are not the source of all our ills, and can offer a too-
         easy target for politicians keen to divert attention from inadequately resourced schools and
          health services.

    当然，社交媒体公司并非我们所有问题的根源，而且它们很容易成为政客们的靶子——政客
    热衷于借此转移人们对投入不足的学校和医疗服务的关注。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确
              inadequately resourced schools and health services ↔

            Poorly financed schools and health services.

      预判候选'投入不足的学校与医疗服务'与 Poorly financed schools and health
             services. 仅修饰语有别，主体名词逐字相同，且它确属'社交媒体公司以外'的因素，锁
      定 A。

        B) 答非所问
              Politicians' eagerness to divert public attention. 取自 politicians keen to divert
       attention，但政客转移视线是对问题的掩盖手段，不是导致年轻人心理问题的成因；题
      干问的是 contribute to 心理问题的因素，此项答非所问。

        C) 答非所问
          Bad statutory regulation of digital media giants. 借自 P4 Statutory regulation of
           the digital media giants is long overdue.——监管缺位针对的正是数字媒体巨头本
      身，属于'社交媒体公司'这一条线，而题干用 Besides social media companies 明确把
      这条线排除在外；且 P5 列举的其他原因里也根本没有它。

        D) 偷换概念
      原文的另一成因是 increasing pressure to succeed in education and in life more
       broadly——年轻人自己在教育和人生上的成功压力；Their parents' educational
          background and life. 把 education and life 的原词留下，却硬是安上 parents' 这个原
       文没有的主体，把'自身压力'偷换成'父母背景'。

P9 段号、逐段附中文翻译）；之后 5 道题逐题排列，每题英文题干与选项后紧接本题

真题卷第1套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part III Section C (2)


Directions: There  are 2 passages  in  this  section. Each passage  is  followed by some  questions or
unfinished statements. For each of them there are four choices marked A)  , B)  , C) and D)  . You should
decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding  letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single  line
through the centre.

Passage Two
Questions 51 to 55 are based on the following passage.

    P1 About a decade ago, the G-20, a forum of the world's biggest economies, agreed to crack down
on multinational corporations' abusive use of tax havens. This resulted in a plan  that aimed to curb
practices that shielded a large chunk of corporate profits from tax authorities.
大约十年前，作为世界最大经济体论坛的二十国集团同意严厉打击跨国公司滥用避税天堂的行为。这促成
了一项计划，旨在遏制那些使企业利润中的很大一部分逃避税务机关监管的做法。

    P2 But, instead of reining in the use of tax havens—countries such as the Bahamas and Cayman
Islands with very low or no effective tax rates—the problem has only gotten worse.
然而，避税天堂的使用非但没有得到遏制——避税天堂包括巴哈马和开曼群岛等实际税率极低或为零的国
家和地区——这一问题反而变得更加严重。

    P3 In a new  study, we measured  the  excessive  profits  reported  in  tax havens  that cannot be
explained by ordinary economic activity such as employees, factories and research in that country. Our
findings show a striking pattern of artificial shifting of paper profits to tax havens by corporations, which
has been relentless since the 1980s.
在一项最新研究中，我们测算了避税天堂申报的超额利润，其中有一部分无法用该国的雇员、工厂和研发
等正常经济活动来解释。我们的研究结果显示，企业将账面利润人为转移至避税天堂的现象十分明显，而
且自20世纪80年代以来一直持续不断。





               懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/cet6/sections/2026-06-1/part3-section-c-2/?f=p · 在线使用效果更好

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第1套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
P4 We found  that the world's biggest multinational businesses  shifted 37% of the profits—$969
billion—they earned in other countries to tax havens in 2019. The figure was less than 2% in the 1970s.
The main reasons for the large increase were the growth of the tax avoidance industry in the 1980s and
U.S. policies that made it easier to shift profits from high-tax countries to tax havens.
我们发现，2019年，全球最大的跨国企业将其在其他国家赚取的利润中的37%（9690亿美元）转移到了
避税天堂。20世纪70年代，这一比例还不到2%。这一比例大幅上升的主要原因，是20世纪80年代避税行
业的发展，以及美国的相关政策使得企业更容易将利润从高税率国家转移到避税天堂。

    P5 We estimate that the amount of corporate taxes lost as a result reached 10% of total corporate
revenue in 2019, up from less than 0.1% in the 1970s. In 2019, the total government tax loss globally
was $250 billion. U.S. multinational corporations alone accounted for about half of that, followed by the
U.K. and Germany.
我们估计，2019年因此损失的企业税额已达到企业总收入的10%，而20世纪70年代还不到0.1%。2019
年，全球政府税收损失总额为2500亿美元。其中，仅美国跨国公司就占了约一半，其后是英国和德国。

    P6 How do policymakers  fix  this? So  far, the world as a whole has been  trying  to solve  this
problem by cutting or scrapping corporate taxes in a very gradual way. In the past 40 years, the global
effective corporate tax rate has fallen from 23% to 17%. At the same time, governments have relied
more heavily on consumption taxes.
政策制定者应如何解决这一问题？到目前为止，世界各国总体上一直试图通过非常渐进地削减或取消企业
税来解决这一问题。在过去40年里，全球企业实际税率已从23%降至17%。与此同时，各国政府越来越
依赖消费税。

    P7 But  the  root cause of  profit-shifting  is  the  incentives involved, such as generous or  lenient
corporate tax rates in other countries. If countries could agree on a global minimum corporate tax rate
of, say, 20%, the problem of profit-shifting would largely disappear, as tax havens would simply cease to
exist.
但利润转移的根本原因在于相关激励措施，例如其他国家慷慨或宽松的企业税率。如果各国能够就全球最
低企业税率达成一致，比如确定为20%，利润转移问题将基本消失，因为避税天堂将不复存在。

    P8 This type of mechanism  is exactly what more than 130 countries signed onto in 2021, with
implementation of a 15% minimum tax set to begin soon in the EU, U.K., Japan, Indonesia and many
other countries. The U.S. has notably not been able to pass this legislation.
这类机制正是2021年由130多个国家签署支持的方案；欧盟、英国、日本、印度尼西亚以及许多其他国家
将很快开始实施15%的最低税率。值得注意的是，美国一直未能通过这项立法。

    P9 Our research suggests implementing this type of tax reform is necessary in reversing the shift of
ever-greater amounts of corporate  profits  to  tax havens—instead of being taxed by  the governments
where they operate and create value.
我们的研究表明，实施这类税制改革对于扭转企业利润越来越多地流向避税天堂的趋势是必要的；这些利
润本应由企业开展经营并创造价值所在国的政府征税。

text:
51. What do we learn about the G-20's agreement on curbing the use of tax havens?

   A) It has aggravated the problem in non-G-20 countries.

   B) It has taken a toll on countries such as Cayman Islands.

   C) It has failed to achieve the expected outcome.

   D) It has failed to result in any long-term plan.

我们从G20遏制避税天堂使用的协议中了解到什么？
A) 加剧了非G20国家的问题。  B) 对开曼群岛等国家造成了损失。  C) 未能达到预期效果。

D) 未能形成任何长期计划。
【答案】C （细节题）

【判型】What do we learn about the G-20's agreement...? 询问关于该协议的事实信息，没有
         infer/suggest/imply 等推断标志。

【拆句】What do we learn about the G-20's agreement on curbing the use of tax havens? 为
    主谓宾结构，介词 on 后接动名词短语作后置修饰，整体无否定、比较等陷阱，平铺直叙。

【定位】About a decade ago, the G-20, a forum of the world's biggest economies, agreed to crack
       down on multinational corporations' abusive use of tax havens. This resulted in a plan that
        aimed to curb practices that shielded a large chunk of corporate profits from tax authorities.
         But, instead of reining in the use of tax havens—countries such as the Bahamas and Cayman
          Islands with very low or no effective tax rates—the problem has only gotten worse.

    大约十年前，世界最大经济体论坛 G-20 同意打击跨国企业滥用避税天堂的行为。这产生了

52. What mainly accounted for the large increase in the world's biggest multinational corporations' shift
    of profits to tax havens?

   A) Fluctuating tax rates globally.

   B) Lenient policies of the U.S.

   C) Heavy taxes imposed on them.

【答案】B （细节题）

   A) Reducing corporate taxes step by step.

54. What does the author say would bring tax havens to an end?

   A) The alignment of corporate taxes with consumption taxes.

   B) The implementation of generous tax rates in all countries.

   C) The agreement on the root cause of global profit-shifting.

   D) The imposition of a global minimum corporate tax rate.

作者说什么将终结避税天堂？

A) 使企业税与消费税保持一致。  B) 在所有国家实行优惠税率。

C) 就全球利润转移的根本原因达成一致。  D) 征收全球最低企业税率。
【答案】D （细节题）

【判型】What does the author say would bring tax havens to an end? 直接询问作者提出的条
    件与结果，没有 infer/suggest 等推断标志。

【拆句】What does the author say would bring tax havens to an end? 中，What 引导宾语从
      句，would bring... to an end 是固定短语表'使...终结'，整体询问作者提出的充分条件。

【定位】If countries could agree on a global minimum corporate tax rate of, say, 20%, the problem of
           profit-shifting would largely disappear, as tax havens would simply cease to exist.

    如果各国能就比如说 20% 的全球最低企业所得税率达成一致，利润转移问题就会基本消
    失，因为避税天堂将不复存在。

55. What could be expected of the global problem of profit-shifting in the near future?

   A) It would be solved with more countries cutting tax rates.

A) 随着更多国家降低税率，这一问题将得到解决。

B) 随着各国政府意识到其严重性，这一问题将会结束。

C) 随着全球企业的支持，这一问题将不复存在。  D) 由于美国不合作，这一问题将会持续下去。

corporate profits from tax authorities.

第1段，第2句

“主句 + 宾语 + 定语从句修饰宾语 + 嵌套定语从句”在各类英语考试阅读中高频出现，掌握该句型

In a new study, we measured the excessive profits reported in tax havens that
cannot be explained by ordinary economic activity such as employees, factories
and research in that country.

第3段，第1句

“主句 + 后置分词短语 + 限制性定语从句 + 举例介词短语”是四六级与考研阅读中极具代表性的学
术论文句式，掌握后复用价值极高。



Our findings show a striking pattern of artificial shifting of paper profits to tax
havens by corporations, which has been relentless since the 1980s.

第3段，第2句

主句带长后置定语、句末加逗号带 'which' 引导非限制性定语从句补充说明，是四六级与考研阅读
学术真题中最常见的句型结构之一，极具迁移价值。



The main reasons for the large increase were the growth of the tax avoidance
industry in the 1980s and U.S. policies that made it easier to shift profits from
high-tax countries to tax havens.

第4段，第3句

句中 'make it + 宾补 + 真实宾语' 的形式宾语结构以及 'nouns + that ...' 限定性定语从句是学术英
语与各类英语考试高频出现的典型句式，迁移价值极高。



We estimate that the amount of corporate taxes lost as a result reached 10% of
total corporate revenue in 2019, up from less than 0.1% in the 1970s.

第5段，第1句

句式非常标准典型，属于四六级及考研阅读中高频出现的“主语 + 观点谓语 + that 宾语从句（含数

真题卷第1套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part IV


Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English.
You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.

  科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展。近年来，远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者。医
学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询，指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案。人工智能辅助诊
断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，提高诊断准确率。电子健康档案的普及让医生能够快速了解患
者病史，避免重复检查。线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊。科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满
足了人民的健康需求。


参考译文
整篇参考英译是复盘资产，考卷上只印中文原文——四六级 Part IV 翻译按整篇「表达通顺连贯、用词准确、语法
正确」四档评分。

    Advances in science and technology have brought about the rapid development of China's medical

services.  In  recent  years,  telemedicine  has made  high-quality  medical  resources  accessible  to more

patients. Through video  links, medical experts can provide consultations for patients in remote  areas,

guiding local doctors in developing and implementing treatment plans. AI-assisted diagnosis systems help

doctors identify patients' early symptoms, thereby improving the accuracy of diagnosis. The widespread

adoption of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly review patients' medical histories, thus

avoiding  repeated  examinations.  Online  medical  consultation  platforms  have  also  greatly  facilitated

patients' access to medical care. Overall, the deep integration of technology and healthcare has better met

people's health needs.

text:
【衔接】第1、2句间用时间状语承接

     近年来自带时间推进，译 In recent years 置于第2句句首，自然把远程医疗这个实例挂到首句得到
     快速发展的总起之后，无需另加关联词。

    四个并列实例句群，只在末例补 also
     第3至6句是四个并列的应用实例（远程咨询、AI诊断、电子档案、线上平台），若每句都加
        moreover／in addition 会关联词堆砌、反而生硬；只在最后一例句首补一个 also（Online
         medical consultation platforms have also...），标示「再举一例、举例将尽」，轻重得当。

    总结句前补 Overall

     末句科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求是对前文的收束，中文靠语序暗示、英文
     需显性标记，句首补 Overall（Overall, the deep integration of technology and healthcare
        has better met...），把「举例→总结」的信息流显化给阅卷人。


逐句解析
一整段连排中文、无段落标记无题号——把它切成一句句翻译单元本身就是解题动作，句前 N. 为逐句解析自切的
句序号（非考卷题号），与卷面中文逐字对应。

【主旨】科技赋能中国医疗的正式客观介绍

     P1是典型的六级式社会科技介绍段：首句科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展总起，中间逐一
     举远程医疗、人工智能诊断、电子健康档案、线上平台四个应用实例，末句科技与医疗的深度融合
     更好地满足了人民的健康需求收束升华。语体正式客观，英文用词应偏书面（consultation、
           facilitate 优于口语说法），句式以主谓主干句为主。

【时态】一般现在时

     通篇客观介绍科技给中国医疗带来的现状与功能，陈述的是当下的一般事实与能力，如可以通过视
     频为偏远地区患者提供咨询、帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，故全篇以一般现在时为基调；凡带
     「了」「近年来」、表示已成结果的句子（如得到快速发展、极大地方便了患者就诊）合理偏离为
     现在完成时，表示动作已发生且结果延续至今。

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第1套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
【译法】科技进步

     统一译作 advances in science and technology（约定俗成的固定搭配，advances 用复数表「多
     方面的进步」），锚回科技进步，全篇不再换用 technology development 等自造说法。

    医疗事业
     统一译作 medical services（也可作 healthcare，但全篇只取 medical services 一种），锚回医
     疗事业；「事业」在此语境下不译 cause/undertaking。

    远程医疗

     统一译作 telemedicine，这是国际通用的约定俗成译名，锚回远程医疗；不要自造 long-distance
         medical care 这类中式表达。

    优质医疗资源

     统一译作 high-quality medical resources（resources 用复数），锚回优质医疗资源。

    偏远地区
     统一译作 remote areas，作后置定语时为 in remote areas，锚回偏远地区患者。

    人工智能辅助诊断系统

     统一译作 AI-assisted diagnosis systems（AI-assisted 为连字符复合形容词，systems 复数表一
     类事物），锚回人工智能辅助诊 断系统；AI 为公认缩写，正式译文中可直接使用。

    电子健康档案
     统一译作 electronic health records（records 用复数），锚回电子健康档案，即国际通用的
     EHR，全篇不混用 electronic medical files。

    线上医疗咨询平台
     统一译作 online medical consultation platforms（platforms 复数），锚回线上医疗咨询平台；
     「咨询」取书面词 consultation，不用 asking doctors 这类口语。

    治疗方案

     统一译作 treatment plans（plans 复数），锚回治疗方案。

1. 科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展。

【主干】科技进步作主语，带来作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）

     科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展的核心动作是「使……得到快速发展」，提主干为
        Advances in science and technology（主语）+ have brought about（谓语）+ the rapid
        development of China's medical services（宾语）；「中国的医疗事业」整体降为宾语内部的修
     饰成分。

【降级】「使……得到发展」并入一个及物动词

     「使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展」不宜逐字译成 make China's medical services get
     developed（典型中式英语），把「快速发展」做成名词短语 the rapid development of China's
         medical services 作宾语，用一个及物动词 brought about（带来）即可完整承载「使……得到」
     的因果语义。

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第1套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
【语法】时态

     得到快速发展表示已发生且延续至今的结果，此处偏离全篇一般现在时的基调，改用现在完成时
        have brought about；若用一般现在时 brings about，会丢掉「已然实现」的意味。

    主谓一致
     主语中心词 advances 是复数，助动词用 have，不要误写为 has。

    冠词与单复数

        development 被 of China's medical services 限定为特指，前面加 the；medical services 用复
     数表医疗服务的统称。

【译文】Advances in science and technology have brought about the rapid development of

         China's medical services.

2. 近年来，远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者。

【主干】远程医疗作主语，使资源可及作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）

     远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者的主语「远程医疗」照搬为 telemedicine；「使优质医疗资
     源惠及更多患者」用英文惯用复合宾语结构 has made high-quality medical resources
          accessible to more patients——「惠及」没有一个逐字对应的英文动词，make sth accessible
         to sb 是地道对译。

【降级】「近年来」降为时间状语前置

     本句主干之外只有近年来一个成分，译为时间状语 In recent years 置于句首，既符合英文把时间
     状语放句首标示话题的习惯，又天然起到承接上句的作用；句内其余部分无需再降级。

【语法】时态
     「近年来」标示从过去持续到现在，是现在完成时的典型信号，用 has made；这是基调时态的合
     理偏离。

    主谓一致
     主语 telemedicine 是不可数单数，助动词用 has，不要受中文无单复数标记影响写成 have。

    单复数

      「优质医疗资源」「更多患者」均为复数概念：high-quality medical resources、more
         patients，patients 不要漏掉 s。

【译文】In recent years, telemedicine has made high-quality medical resources accessible to

       more patients.

3. 医学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询，指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案。

【主干】医学专家作主语，提供咨询作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）

     医学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询给出明确主语「医学专家」→medical experts，
     谓语取「提供咨询」→can provide consultations；后半句指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案不另
     立谓语，留给降级处理。

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第1套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
【降级】方式状语前置，伴随动作分词化

     「通过视频」→介词短语 Through video links 作方式状语置句首；「为偏远地区患者」→for
          patients in remote areas，其中「偏远地区」用介词短语 in remote areas 作 patients 的后置定
     语，不堆在名词前；「指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案」→现在分词短语 guiding local doctors
          in developing and implementing treatment plans 作伴随状语，「制定并实施」在 guide sb in
        doing sth 框架内用 and 连接两个动名词。

【语法】时态与情态
     回指全篇基调用一般现在时，can 后接动词原形 provide；本句陈述的是当下的能力，不用完成
     时。

    介词搭配
         provide sth for sb（为某人提供某物）与 guide sb in doing sth（指导某人做某事）是固定搭
     配，介词 for／in 不可换、不可省。

    单复数

         consultations、treatment plans 均用复数表泛指的一类；experts、doctors 复数与中文「专家
     们／医生们」的群体义一致。

【译文】Through video links, medical experts can provide consultations for patients in

        remote areas, guiding local doctors in developing and implementing treatment plans.

4. 人工智能辅助诊 断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，提高诊断准确率。

【主干】诊断系统作主语，帮助识别作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）

     人工智能辅助诊 断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状主语照搬为 AI-assisted diagnosis systems
        （systems 复数表一类事物），谓语用 help sb do 结构：help doctors identify patients' early
      symptoms；「识别」紧跟 help 用原形。

【降级】「提高准确率」降为结果状语

     提高诊断准确率是「帮助识别早期症状」带来的结果，译为 thereby improving the accuracy of
         diagnosis 作结果状语挂句尾；「诊断准确率」不直译为 diagnosis correct rate（中式），用 the
         accuracy of diagnosis 这个名词化表达。

【语法】时态
     陈述系统的一般功能，回指全篇基调用一般现在时 help。

    动词用法
         help 后接不带 to 的不定式：help doctors identify（to identify 也算对，但 identify 更简洁）；
     不要误写 help doctors identifying。

    单复数

        systems、doctors、symptoms 均用复数；symptoms 最易漏 s，注意「患者的早期症状」是多
     个症状。

【译文】AI-assisted diagnosis systems help doctors identify patients' early symptoms, thereby

        improving the accuracy of diagnosis.

text:
5. 电子健康档案的普及让医生能够快速了解患 者病史，避免重复检查。

【主干】普及作主语，使医生能够作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）

     电子健康档案的普及是「动词＋的＋名词」结构，译成名词化短语 The widespread adoption of
          electronic health records 作整句主语；「让医生能够」用 enable sb to do：enables doctors
         to quickly review patients' medical histories。

【降级】「避免重复检查」降为结果状语

     避免重复检查是「快速了解病史」的直接结果，用 thus avoiding repeated examinations 作结果
     状语挂句尾；「让」译作 enable sb to do 已含「能够」义，「能够」不再另译 can，避免
          enable...to be able to 的冗余。

【语法】主谓一致
     主语中心词是 adoption（单数），不是 records，谓语用 enables——长主语里隔着 of 短语时，
     最容易被末尾的复数名词带偏。

    时态
     陈述现实功能，回指基调用一般现在时。

    单复数

         records、histories 用复数；「病史」也可作 a patient's medical history，两种译法取一即可，
     全篇保持可数名词标记完整。

【译文】The widespread adoption of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly

         review patients' medical histories, thus avoiding repeated examinations.

6. 线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊。

【主干】平台作主语，方便就诊作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）

     线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊主语照搬为 Online medical consultation platforms；
     「方便了患者就诊」不逐字译 convenient for patients to see doctors（中式且破碎），用
           facilitate ＋名词化宾语：have greatly facilitated patients' access to medical care。

【降级】「极大地」作副词修饰谓语

     本句结构简单，无需降级：「极大地」→副词 greatly 直接修饰谓语动词；「患者就诊」名词化为
          patients' access to medical care 作宾语，access to 是固定搭配。

【语法】时态
     「方便了」表已成事实且影响延续，偏离基调用现在完成时 have facilitated。

    主谓一致与单复数

     主语 platforms 复数，助动词用 have；platforms 的 s 不可漏。

    介词搭配
         access to 中的 to 是介词固定搭配，不可换成 for 或 of。

【译文】Online medical consultation platforms have greatly facilitated patients' access to

        medical care.

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第1套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
7. 科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求。

【主干】深度融合作主语，满足需求作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）

     科技与医疗的深度融合译成名词化主语 The deep integration of technology and healthcare
         （integration 为中心词）；谓语「满足了」→has met；宾语人民的健康需求→people's health
        needs，needs 用复数。

【降级】「更好地」作副词嵌入谓语

     本句为简单句，无成分需降级：「更好地」→better 置于助动词与过去分词之间（has better
     met），修饰「满足」的程度。

【语法】主谓一致
     主语中心词 integration 是单数，助动词用 has；不要被 of 后面的 technology and healthcare
     两个名词带成 have。

    时态
     「更好地满足了」呼应全篇「已经实现的成果」，用现在完成时 has met，与首句 have brought
        about 首尾呼应。

    单复数

     「健康需求」是多种需求，needs 用复数；meet one's needs 为固定搭配。

【译文】The deep integration of technology and healthcare has better met people's

         health needs.

         六级 · 真题卷第2套 · 2026年6月


Part I                              Writing                                (30 minutes)
Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "In an
era of rapid social development,  it is vitally important to enhance young people's sense of responsibility."
You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write
at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning
of your essay.



Part II                       Listening Comprehension                       (30 minutes)

Section A
Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear
four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you
must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding
letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.

Questions 1 to 4 are based on the conversation you have just heard.

1. A) Celebrate his 10th wedding anniversary.

  B) Celebrate his promotion in Barcelona.

  C) Give his wife a pleasant surprise.

  D) Ask for leave to visit Barcelona.

2. A) He is unable to find some inexpensive accommodation.

  B) There are few warm places to go at this time of the year.

  C) There is so much for him to do before going on vacation.

  D) He is afraid Barcelona may not be so fabulous as expected.

    What does  self-discipline  look  like  at work? Sometimes,  it's  the  ability  to  resist  temptation, such  as
distractions to avoid a particular task. Other times  it's the ability to persist with a task when your energy and
motivation seem low.

    What do you believe about the nature of your own self-discipline?  Is  it something that runs on internal
energy that is spent with use? Or is it something that is bolstered as you apply it and persist?

    Your answer  matters,  as  it determines how much  self-discipline you  experience. For  years,  research  in
psychology pointed  to  self-control as a resource  that  is depleted with use and needs  to be restored through
breaks,  rest, or sleep. More recently, however, research points to the importance of mindset.  If you view self-
discipline as an expendable resource, your willpower tends to fade with use. If you believe that exercising your
self-control strengthens and fuels  it, that is more likely to be your experience as you resist temptation or push
yourself to get something done that is not appealing.

      If you don't already view self-discipline as a force that feeds  itself, what might you do? Reflect on times
that you had  initial difficulty resisting temptation, getting started on something, or sticking with  it, but pushed
ahead and accomplished the task or met the goal. That's the kind of experience we're talking about with this
particular  belief about  self-discipline, and you've already had such an experience, so you've shown  that  it's
possible. When you feel your willpower and motivation fading, remind yourself of those previous experiences
and imagine the same happening now.

    What  if your experiences have always seemed to indicate that your self-control diminishes with use, and
you need breaks to recharge? There's nothing wrong with that as long as you can afford to take those breaks. If
not,  remind  yourself  that  not  everyone  experiences  self-discipline  as  a  depletable  resource and  that  your
experience might be different  if you focus on gathering more energy at this point rather than focusing on how
difficult it is to continue or the need for a break.

     Also,  if you know someone who  is a role model of self-discipline, picture that person in your situation,
persisting in the task. Regardless of how you do  it, as you push forward to continue to accomplish progress, be
sure to mentally reinforce yourself by taking pride in your ability to exert more willpower as you persist.

commerce) 使城市消费者能够与卖家实时互动，已成为促进农村发展的一种新方式。电子商务打破了城乡之间
的信息壁垒，拓宽了农产品销售渠道，帮助农村居民增收致富。数字经济与乡村振兴的深度融合，正在为中国
农村发展注入前所未有的活力。

本页写作题面、参考范文与逐段解析由懒笔记基于2026年6月·第2套 英语六级写作原卷整

束）连续排印。写作是生产性任务、无 ABCD 标准答案——题面即整道题；卷面下方直
接给出满足全部硬约束的参考范文、整篇中译与逐段拆解。



真题卷第2套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part I


Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence
"In an era of rapid social development,  it is vitally important to enhance young people's sense of
responsibility." You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your
essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence
given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.

【参考范文 · 161 词】 写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范

In an era of rapid social development, it is vitally important to enhance young people's sense of responsibility.

As society changes at an unprecedented pace, young people often face distractions and pressures that weaken

their commitment to family, community, and the future. Without a strong sense of responsibility, they may

become self-centered and short-sighted.

The decline of responsibility among youth is partly caused by the instant gratification culture brought by

technology and social media. Many young people are used to receiving immediate rewards and may avoid

duties that require long-term effort. To address this problem, schools and families should work together to

cultivate accountability through real tasks and role models. For example, involving students in community

service can help them understand the value of contributing to society.

In conclusion, enhancing young people's sense of responsibility is not only a personal virtue but also a social

necessity. Only when the younger generation takes responsibility seriously can society achieve sustainable

development and harmony.

【参考译文】

在社会快速发展的时代，提升年轻人的责任感至关重要。随着社会以前所未有的速度变化，年轻人常常面
临分散注意力和压力，这些因素削弱了他们对家庭、社区和未来的承诺。如果没有强烈的责任感，他们可
能会变得以自我为中心、目光短浅。

text:
年轻人责任感的下降，部分是由科技和社交媒体带来的即时满足文化造成的。许多年轻人习惯于获得即时
回报，可能会回避需要长期付出的职责。为解决这一问题，学校和家庭应共同努力，通过真实任务和榜样
示范来培养责任意识。例如，让学生参与社区服务，可以帮助他们理解为社会做贡献的价值。

总之，提升年轻人的责任感不仅是个人美德，也是社会必需。只有当年轻一代认真对待责任时，社会才能
实现可持续发展与和谐。

【第 1 段】照抄首句后自然释义并立论。首句使用题目给定的“In an era of rapid social development,
it is vitally important to enhance young people's sense of responsibility.”，随后用“As society
changes...”解释社会发展与责任感之间的关系，再以“Without a strong sense of responsibility...”点出缺
失责任感的后果，顺势引出后文论证。

【第 2 段】因果分析+对策+例子完整论证。本段先用“The decline of responsibility among youth is
partly caused by...”分析问题原因，再用“To address this problem...”提出家校协同的对策，最后用“For
example, involving students in community service...”给出具体例子，并回扣到为社会做贡献的价值，
避免空泛。

【第 3 段】总结升华并用强调句收尾。结论段用“In conclusion”收束全文，将责任感从个人层面提升到
社会层面，再用“Only when... can society achieve...”的倒装强调句增强说服力，呼应首段提出的时代
背景。



A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意

这道题到底要写什么、立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些
是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。





  核心任务

  围绕“提升年轻人责任感”写议论文

  本题的写作任务是：以In an era of rapid social development, it is vitally important to enhance
   young people's sense of responsibility.为文章开头，写一篇议论性短文，通过评论、举例或个
  人经历来论证为何以及如何提升年轻人的责任感。





  读者 · 语域

 面向阅卷人的正式书面语

  这是一道六级议论文写作，没有具体交际对象，写作身份是考生本人，读者是阅卷教师。因此
  语言应正式、客观，避免口语化缩写、过度情绪化和网络用语，用完整的复合句和恰当的衔接
  词展示论证能力。

中心立意

 责任感是青年成长与社会稳定的共同需要

  中心论点：在社会快速发展的时代，提升年轻人的责任感不仅关系到他们自身的人格成熟，也
  关系到社会的可持续和谐，因此家庭、学校和社会都应共同发力。





  要展开的要点

      1. 问题：科技发展削弱责任感

   现代社会节奏快、诱惑多，年轻人容易沉迷即时满足，忽视对家庭、集体和未来的责任，这是
   需要被正视的现实问题。

      2. 对策：家校社协同培养担当

   通过家庭教育、学校实践和社会服务，让年轻人在真实任务中体验责任、建立习惯，把抽象的
   责任感变成具体行动。

      3. 意义：责任感成就个人与社会

   当年轻人具备责任感，他们更能抵御短期诱惑、做出长远选择，社会也因此获得稳定发展的中
   坚力量。

 第 2 段 论证段：问题分析+对策举例

字数格式  首句必须逐字照抄
         本题要求开头原样照抄给定句子，自查时把范文首句与Directions中的句子逐词比
        对，任何一个词的增减或顺序变化都属于硬约束失误。




典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法


 把责任感泛化成责任行为

  反面示例：Young people should be responsible for their work, family and society. This is very
   important. 问题：只罗列了要承担的责任，没有谈“责任感”本身。修正：Cultivating a strong sense
   of responsibility helps young people voluntarily fulfill their duties to work, family and society.


 建议空洞无具体路径

  反面示例：We should work hard to enhance young people's sense of responsibility. 问题：没有说
  明怎么努力、谁来努力。修正：Schools can design volunteer programs that require students to
   complete real community tasks, so they experience the consequences of their actions firsthand.


 照抄首句后另起炉灶

  反面示例：In an era of rapid social development, it is vitally important to enhance young people's
   sense of responsibility. Nowadays young people face many problems. They should study hard. 问
  题：首句与后文断裂。修正：In an era of rapid social development, it is vitally important to
   enhance young people's sense of responsibility, because a society cannot function well without
   responsible young citizens.


 全文多为简单句并列

  反面示例：Social development is fast. Young people are busy. They forget responsibility. We must
   help them. 问题：四句都是简单句，缺乏论证深度。修正：Because social development is so fast,
   young people are often too busy to reflect on their responsibilities, which is why we must help
  them regain this awareness.

【翻译】据说是什么决定了地球的整体温度？
         A) 空气中固体颗粒的积聚。  B) 其大气层中气体的分布。  C) 反射太阳光线的颗粒云。

【答案】B （细节题）The distribution of gases in its atmosphere.

【定位】But on Earth, the overall temperature of the planet is dominated by the distribution of gases in
         our atmosphere.

    但在地球上，行星的整体温度是由大气中气体的分布所主导的。

【信号】转折后给出地球情况的结论。录音先用 Pluto 的 haze 机制做铺垫，随后用 But on Earth
    一转，指出 the overall temperature of the planet is dominated by the distribution
         of gases in our atmosphere，直接回答题干中的 determine the overall temperature
       on Earth。

【替换】the overall temperature of the planet is dominated by the distribution of gases in our atmosphere ↔

        The distribution of gases in its atmosphere.

      A 项的 solid particles in the air 直接来自 solid particles get suspended in the air，但

          reflect the Sun's rays into the atmosphere，但那是火山喷发后的局部现象，不是决定地
    球整体温度的主因。
         借用原文：clouds of particles that reflect the Sun's rays into the atmosphere

        D) 与原文相反

      D 项说 climate change 的加剧效应决定温度，而原文 alleviate the effects of climate
       change 讲的是‘缓解’气候变化，并非‘加剧’；选项把 alleviating 偷换成 aggravated，极性
    相反。

         A) 望远镜能否更好地探测到光谱。  B) 能否更容易地观测到冥王星的霾状大气层。

         C) 冥王星的霾状大气层是否会散射强烈的阳光。
         D) 望远镜接收到的光是否证实他们的想法。

【答案】D （细节题）If the light from the telescope confirms their idea.

          bright idea.

        see 与题干中的 wait and see 完全对应，随后的 if 从句就是答案所在。

a literature review into more than a dozen studies looking at parental musical influence. "Children have

an openness to new music, and  this means parents have an important role to play in developing the

musical preferences of their kids," he said.

研究人员得出结论，父母有一个短暂的窗口期，可以影响8至10岁孩子的音乐品味。这段24个月的时期处
于这样一个年龄阶段：孩子已经足够大，能够欣赏富有诗意的歌词和朗朗上口的曲调，但还没有开始因
父母的音乐偏好而感到尴尬。约克大学音乐讲师豪克·埃格尔曼博士对十多项有关父母音乐影响的研究进
行了文献综述。他说：“孩子对新音乐持开放态度，这意味着父母在培养孩子的音乐偏好方面扮演着重要
角色。”

2 However, time is of the essence as parental influence is most likely to be effective during the critical

time period before age  ten. During adolescence,  children tend  to  gravitate away from  their  parents'

choices and are more influenced by  their peers. A separate survey of 2,000 British parents by music

streaming service Deezer also found that nearly four-fifths of parents agreed that their children were far

more receptive to their musical suggestions before the age of ten. In contrast, just 10 percent of parents

reported positive reactions from their teenage children when they shared their favorite music. Some 79

percent of fathers said they had tried to influence their children's music, but just 69 percent of mothers.

However, mothers were more effective, with 38 percent reporting that their kids loved the tunes they

shared, compared to 30 percent of dads who, in some cases, said their children cried or even fell asleep.

然而，时间至关重要，因为父母的影响最有可能在十岁以前这一关键时期发挥作用。进入青春期后，孩子
往往会逐渐远离父母的选择，并更多地受到同龄人的影响。音乐流媒体服务Deezer对2000名英国父母进
行的另一项调查也发现，近五分之四的父母认为，孩子在十岁以前更容易接受他们的音乐建议。相比之
下，只有10%的父母表示，孩子进入青少年时期后，在他们分享自己喜爱的音乐时会作出积极反应。约
79%的父亲表示曾试图影响孩子的音乐选择，而母亲的这一比例仅为69%。不过，母亲的影响更有效：
38%的母亲表示孩子喜欢她们分享的曲调，而父亲中只有30%的人得到这样的反馈；有些父亲甚至表示，
孩子听着听着哭了起来，或者睡着了。

3 Dr. Egermann claims introducing children to a variety of musical styles is the key to fostering good

taste  in  later  life. "By playing  children a  variety  of genres  before  this  critical  period,  research on

familiarization suggests they will enjoy lots of different types of music as adults," he added. The benefits

of having a wider taste in music include the ability to manage their emotions more effectively, socialize

and bond with others more easily, and to have a better understanding of other cultures as well.

埃格尔曼博士认为，让孩子接触各种各样的音乐风格，是培养他们日后良好音乐品味的关键。他补充说：
“有关熟悉化的研究表明，在这一关键时期之前让孩子聆听多种音乐类型，他们成年后将会喜欢许多不同
种类的音乐。”拥有更广泛的音乐品味所带来的益处包括更有效地管理情绪、更容易与他人交往并建立联
系，以及更好地理解其他文化。

4 Dr. Egermann advises parents not to push their favorite music too hard on their children, but instead

play  it as background music while a child is playing. They can also help create positive memories about

artists and bands by going to concerts and live music events together.

埃格尔曼博士建议，父母不要过分强迫孩子接受自己喜爱的音乐，而应在孩子玩耍时将其作为背景音乐播
放。他们还可以通过一起参加音乐会和现场音乐活动，帮助孩子对音乐家和乐队形成积极的记忆。

具有很强的可迁移性。



I really do recommend visiting that cathedral.

第7段，第3句

M: Considering Jane is terrified of heights, I think if I tried to make her do that, I
would come back divorced.

第8段，第1句

本句涵盖了前置介词从句短语、主谓宾结构、非谓语动词复合结构（使役动词搭配）以及主语补足

及物动词后接省略 "that" 的宾语从句，且从句以动名词短语开头的句式在学术阅读和真题中极具代
表性，迁移复用价值高。



"By playing children a variety of genres before this critical period, research on
familiarization suggests they will enjoy lots of different types of music as adults,"
he added.

第3段，第2句

“句首介词短语状语 + 动词引出宾语从句 + 句末引述主句”是阅读理解与外刊中极为常见的学术引
用句式，具有极高的高考、四六级与考研真题代表性。

Dr. Egermann advises parents not to push their favorite music too hard on their
children, but instead play it as background music while a child is playing.

第4段，第1句

包含“动词 + 宾语 + 宾补（并列否定与肯定）+ 时间状语从句”的结构，是高考与四六级阅读及写作
中高频出现的经典句式。



Parents can play a decisive role in cultivating their children's musical talent.

第22题，A

“主语 + play a role in doing sth” 为极其高频的标准句式，广泛存在于四六级与考研写作及阅读
中，复用价值极高。



Children aged 8 to 10 are old enough to produce poetic lyrics.

第22题，D

包含后置过去分词修饰主语以及形容词加 "enough to do" 搭配，均为四六级与考研真题中的高频
基础句式。



They tend to be more influenced by their peers.

第23题，B

"tend to do sth"（倾向于做某事）以及被动表达 "be influenced by..." 均为各类英语考试及阅读写
作中极高频出现的典型句式，掌握后复用价值很高。



They tend to gravitate away from their homes.

第23题，C

"tend to do sth."（倾向于做某事）是各类英语考试中频频出现的高频固定搭配，句式结构极具代
表性与迁移价值。



What is the key to fostering good taste in later life, according to Dr. Hauke
Egermann?

第24题题干

“What is the key to doing sth, according to sb?”是阅读理解细节题中极具代表性的高频提问句式，
掌握其结构具有很强的可迁移性。

解析



B L A N K S  &  A N A L Y S I S · 选词填空题和解析

选词填空题和解析 · 26–35 题

本页 26–35 题的正确答案词与逐空解析由懒笔记按2026年6月·第2套 英语六级完形填空
（选词填空）原卷词库逐空核对整理。与试卷排版同一卷面：Directions、5 段带空短文
（每段之后紧随中文翻译）与 15 词共享词库连续排印；卷面下方逐空紧跟解析——该空
词性、原文定位句、正确词与锁定依据，以及同词性被淘汰竞争词的逐个归因。



真题卷第2套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part III Section A


Directions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for
each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through
carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the
corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not
use any of the words in the bank more than once.

    Most financial crises have plenty in common: they tend to start in the banking sector and involve
excessive borrowing, together with an asset bubble. The       26       crisis of 2008 was no different, with
the asset bubble focused on US real estate. But my research suggests this crisis had another       27     
cause—that some people  in  the banking  sector were playing or "gaming"  the system  for  their own
financial gain.
大多数金融危机都有许多共同之处：它们往往始于银行业，并伴随着过度借贷和资产泡沫。2008年的全
球危机也不例外，只是当时的资产泡沫集中在美国房地产市场。但我的研究表明，这场危机还有另一个根
本原因——银行业中的一些人为了谋取个人经济利益而操纵或“钻”制度的空子。

    The game being played had several important features. The  first was the deliberate complexity of
the financial products at  its core. Then there are the       28       biases that permeate decision-making at
all  levels of the banking  industry. Banking often  attracts people with  certain personality       29        ,
including those who are overconfident and take excessive risks.
当时所进行的这种操纵具有几个重要特征。首先是其核心金融产品经过了刻意设计，十分复杂。其次，行
为偏差渗透到了银行业各个层面的决策过程中。银行业往往会吸引具有某些性格特征的人，其中包括过度
自信、过度承担风险的人。

    Such people tend to like complexity for  its own sake, but they often do not fully understand the
     30       of that complexity for the stability of the financial system as a whole. Often they do not care
—they are primarily interested in gaming the system to       31       their bonuses.
这类人往往会为了复杂而复杂地追求复杂性，但他们通常并不完全理解这种复杂性对整个金融体系稳定性
的影响。很多时候，他们并不在乎这些影响——他们主要关心的是操纵制度，以使自己的奖金最大化。

The next element  is  risk. There are parts of the banking sector that will always be       32       to
risk, but many bankers have come to feel immune to  its potential impact, because they       33       that,
however recklessly banks behave, governments will always be there to bail them out.
下一个要素是风险。银行业中有些领域始终容易受到风险影响，但许多银行家逐渐觉得自己不会受到风险
潜在影响，因为他们认定，无论银行的行为多么鲁莽，政府总会出手救助它们。

    Gaming in the banking sector seems virtually impossible to       34        . The only effective measure
to end  it would be to make bankers       35       liable for losses, but no government has ever passed such
a law, and no single government could do so on its own, since this would immediately cause their entire
national banking sector to move wholesale to another jurisdiction.
银行业中的这种制度操纵几乎不可能被消除。终结这种行为的唯一有效措施，是让银行家个人对损失承担
责任；但从未有任何政府通过这样的法律，而且任何单一政府也无法独自这样做，因为这会立即导致本国
整个银行业大规模迁往其他司法管辖区。

                     B)  eliminate                   J)  prone

                     C)   fragile               K)  prototypes

                    D)  global                 L)  reassure

                      E)  implications         M)   skeptically

                       F)  maximise             N)   traits

                    G)  overlapping           O)  underlying

                    H)  personally

text:
26. The __(26)__ crisis of 2008 was no different

【答案】D) global 形容词

【词性槽】冠词与名词之间锁形容词

【依据】2008年全球金融危机

     "2008年全球金融危机"是常识性固定表述；文本证据同样充分——上句 Most financial
          crises have plenty in common 谈"多数金融危机"的共性，本句说这场危机 no different
     （也不例外），是在把单场危机放进普遍、整体的尺度里讨论，global 与 Most financial
          crises 的宏阔范围呼应。

【竞争词】A) behavioural 主题词提前抢跑

      全文确实讲行为因素，很多考生会因此把 behavioural 按在这里——但 26 空修饰的是"危机"的
       规模/范围维度，行为分析后文才展开；behavioural crisis 非惯用表达，behavioural 真正的家
      在 28 空 the ___ biases。

          C) fragile fragile不修饰危机

             fragile 意为"脆弱的"，惯用 fragile economy / system；crisis 本身是坏事，再说"脆弱的危
      机"逻辑别扭。

          G) overlapping 重叠的危机无文本支撑

           overlapping 意为"重叠的"，文中没有任何"多场危机重叠"的信息；2008 是一场特定危机，
           overlapping 属无中生有。

          J) prone prone必带to不作前置定语

          prone 的惯用结构是 be prone to sth，几乎不直接放名词前作定语（a prone crisis 不成
      立）；它的正确位置在 32 空 be ___ to risk 的框架里。

          O) underlying underlying修饰原因不修饰危机

           underlying 意为"根本的、潜在的"，惯用 underlying cause / reason；修饰 crisis 语义勉强，
      而它正是 27 空 another ___ cause 的标准答案。





               懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/cet6/sections/2026-06-2/part3-section-a/?f=p · 在线使用效果更好

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第2套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
27. this crisis had another __(27)__ cause—that some people in the banking sector were playing or
"gaming" the system for their own financial gain

【答案】O) underlying 形容词

【词性槽】another与名词之间锁形容词

【依据】表层共性之下的根本原因

    首段先说这场危机与多数危机有共性（银行业、过度借贷、资产泡沫），随即 But 转折：
        But my research suggests this crisis had another __(27)__ cause——在众目所见的共性
     原因**之外/之下**还有一个"根本的"原因。underlying（根本的、潜藏的）正好承载 But
     的对比：表面原因人尽皆知，underlying cause 才是作者研究的新发现；破折号后"银行从
    业者为私利操纵系统"正是这个深层原因的内容。

【竞争词】A) behavioural 主题词眼熟乱选

       本卷最阴的干扰：全文确实讲行为因素，behavioural cause 看似点题——但破折号引出的解释
      强调的是"此前未被点破的深层原因"，重在"潜藏"而非"行为的"；且 28 空 the ___ biases 只能
      由 behavioural 填（behavioural biases 是行为金融学术语），在此提前用掉它，28 空将无词
      可填。

          C) fragile 脆弱的原因搭配不通

             fragile 修饰 cause 语义不通——"脆弱的原因"既非惯用搭配，也与破折号后的操纵行为无关。

          G) overlapping 重叠的原因无中生有

       文中只讲"另一个"原因，没有任何"多个原因重叠"的信息，overlapping 属无中生有。

【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 A) —— 主题词眼熟加篇章呼应的假正当。全文主题就是行为因素，
        behavioural cause 读起来像点题，词性也对、词义也沾边，是本卷错误率最高的选法。但
        another __(27)__ cause—that some people in the banking sector were playing or
        "gaming" the system 的破折号解释强调的是"此前未被点破的深层原因"，且 28 空 the
          ___ biases 只能由 behavioural 填（术语搭配）。防坑一句话：主题词先查它的命定搭配位
    置，别在第一眼像的空提前用掉。





               懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/cet6/sections/2026-06-2/part3-section-a/?f=p · 在线使用效果更好

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第2套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
28. Then  there  are  the  __(28)__  biases  that  permeate  decision-making  at  all  levels  of  the
banking industry

【答案】A) behavioural 形容词

【词性槽】the与名词之间锁形容词

【依据】行为偏差渗透各级决策

        behavioural biases（行为偏差）是行为经济学/金融学的标准术语，指人的系统性心理偏
    差；下句 Banking often attracts people with certain personality traits, including
        those who are overconfident and take excessive risks 的"过度自信、冒大险"正是
        behavioural biases 的具体表现，与空后的 permeate decision-making（渗透各级决策）
    浑然一体。

【竞争词】C) fragile 脆弱的偏差语义错位

             fragile 修饰的是系统、经济等会"破碎"的实体，biases（偏差）无所谓脆弱与否；"脆弱的偏差
      渗透决策"语义不通。

          G) overlapping 重叠的偏差似是而非

           overlapping biases 字面上能组合，是最后的诱惑；但下文所举"过度自信、爱冒险"是类型不同
      的偏差而非"互相重叠"，且 overlapping 与"渗透各级决策"的普遍性描写无关——文中没有任
       何"重叠"信息。

     29. Banking often attracts people with certain personality __(29)__

【答案】N) traits 名词

【词性槽】personality后缺中心名词

【依据】personality traits固定搭配

         personality traits（人格特质）是心理学与日常英语的固定搭配；更直接的证据在空后：
         including those who are overconfident and take excessive risks 用 including 举例
    ——过度自信、冒大险正是"人格特质"的具体内容，例子在给空位下定义。

【竞争词】E) implications 与personality不构成搭配

            implications 意为"影响、含义"，惯用 implications of/for sth；personality implications 不
      是惯用表达，且后文所举"过度自信、爱冒险"是人自身的特质，不是某种"影响"。

          K) prototypes 原型与人格描写脱节

           prototypes 指产品或模型的"原型、雏形"，是具体物；银行业吸引的是具有某些人格特质的
       人，"人格原型"与 overconfident、take excessive risks 的描写对不上。





               懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/cet6/sections/2026-06-2/part3-section-a/?f=p · 在线使用效果更好

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第2套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
30. they  often do not  fully understand  the __(30)__ of  that complexity  for  the  stability of  the
financial system as a whole

【答案】E) implications 名词

【词性槽】the与of夹出名词

【依据】复杂性对稳定的后果

         implications of A for B（A对B的影响/后果）是高频双介词搭配，与空后的 of that
        complexity for the stability 框架完全吻合；"他们并不完全理解那种复杂性对整个金融体
    系稳定性的影响"，又与下句 Often they do not care 衔接自然——不理解影响，所以不
    在乎。

【竞争词】K) prototypes 原型与抽象语境不符

           prototypes 指具体产品/模型的"原型"，而本空要接的是抽象概念 complexity 与 stability 之间
      的关系；"复杂性的原型"语义不通。

     31. they are primarily interested in gaming the system to __(31)__ their bonuses

【答案】F) maximise 动词

【词性槽】目的不定式to后接动词原形

【依据】操纵系统为了奖金最大化

     全文主旨即银行家为私利操纵系统：playing or "gaming" the system for their own
          financial gain。操纵系统的目的自然是让自己的奖金**最大化**，maximise their
        bonuses 与 for their own financial gain 同义呼应，主旨与搭配双重锁定。

【竞争词】B) eliminate 逻辑指向相反

            eliminate 意为"消除"，eliminate their bonuses＝取消自己的奖金，与 for their own
             financial gain 的逐利动机完全相反——典型"正话反说"型干扰。

          I) presume 接不了bonuses这个宾语

          presume 作"假定"讲时多接 that 从句或 presume sth to be；presume their bonuses（"假定
      他们的奖金"）语义不通，操纵系统不是为了"假定奖金"。

          L) reassure 宾语须为人

           reassure 的宾语通常是人（reassure sb），意为"使某人安心"；reassure their bonuses 搭配
      不成立，"让奖金安心"拟人化得毫无道理。





               懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/cet6/sections/2026-06-2/part3-section-a/?f=p · 在线使用效果更好

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第2套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
32. There are parts of the banking sector that will always be __(32)__ to risk

【答案】J) prone 形容词

【词性槽】be与to夹出表语形容词

【依据】be prone to固定搭配

       be prone to sth（易于遭受……）是词典级固定搭配，"银行业总有些部分永远容易遭受风
     险"；且与后半句 but many bankers have come to feel immune to its potential impact
    的 immune to（对……免疫）形成对照：客观上 prone to risk、主观上 feel immune——
        but 转折严丝合缝。

【竞争词】A) behavioural behavioural不作表语接to

        behavioural（行为的）只作前置定语修饰名词（behavioural biases），be behavioural to
              risk 结构不成立。

          C) fragile fragile to搭配不地道

             fragile 语义上与 risk 沾边、最具迷惑性；但英语惯用 be fragile 单独作表语或 be vulnerable
         to，be fragile to risk 不是地道搭配——六级常考"词义对但搭配错"这一坑。

          G) overlapping 与risk语义不接

        overlapping（重叠的）与 risk 连用语义不通，银行部门"重叠于风险"不知所云。

          O) underlying 不作表语形容词接to

        underlying（潜在的）多作前置定语（underlying cause），be underlying to risk 结构不
      成立。

【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 C) —— 词义沾边但搭配不地道。"对风险脆弱"按中文思维完全通
        顺，fragile 词性也对；但英语惯用 be prone / vulnerable to risk，be fragile to 不是地
    道搭配。防坑一句话：当中文直译很顺而英文搭配陌生时，信搭配（be prone to），不信
    直译。

     33. because they __(33)__ that, however recklessly banks behave, governments will always be there
to bail them out

【答案】I) presume 动词

【词性槽】主语后缺谓语且接that从句

【依据】他们认定政府必兜底

         that 从句的内容 however recklessly banks behave, governments will always be there
         to bail them out（无论银行多鲁莽，政府总会救助）正是银行家一种想当然的认定；正因
    为 presume 如此，上句 many bankers have come to feel immune to its potential
     impact（觉得风险伤不到自己）才成立，因果链完整。

【竞争词】L) reassure 句式结构不成立

           reassure 的正确结构是 reassure sb that...（使某人相信……），必须带人作宾语；they
           reassure that... 缺宾语、结构不成立——两个词义虽都沾"相信"的边，句式直接判生死。

34. Gaming in the banking sector seems virtually impossible to __(34)__

【答案】B) eliminate 动词

【词性槽】impossible to后接动词原形

【依据】操纵行为几乎无法消除

    主语 Gaming（操纵行为）是空位的逻辑宾语，"银行业的操纵行为几乎不可能被__"；下句
       The only effective measure to end it 的 end it（终结它）正是 eliminate 的同义改写，
     语义直接锁定——只有"消除/终结"才接得上"唯一有效办法"。

【竞争词】I) presume 与行为现象搭配无义

       "几乎不可能去假定操纵行为"语义不通；presume 的宾语应是某个判断或事实，不是一种行为现
      象，且 presume 更合 33 空 they ___ that 从句的句式。

          L) reassure 宾语须为人且逻辑相反

           reassure 意为"使安心"，宾语须是人；"不可能去安抚操纵行为"搭配不当，且与下句"终结它"的
      指向相反。

     35. The only effective measure to end it would be to make bankers __(35)__ liable for losses

【答案】H) personally 副词

【词性槽】修饰形容词liable须用副词

【依据】personally liable法律追责搭配

     本段谈"终结操纵的唯一有效办法是让银行家__对损失负责"，下句 but no government has
        ever passed such a law 表明这是在讲法律层面的追责；personally liable（个人承担法律
    责任）是法律英语惯用搭配，"追到个人"才解释了为何没有政府敢立此法。

【竞争词】M) skeptically 词义与搭配双不符

             skeptically 意为"怀疑地"，惯常修饰 say、look at 这类言行动词；skeptically liable 既非常见
      搭配，"怀疑地承担责任"语义也不成立，且与下文追责语境完全脱节。

全文主旨

  2008金融危机背后的人为操纵之因

  本文是外刊议论文：首段先承认 Most financial crises have plenty in common（多数金融危机
  都有共性），随即用 But 转折抛出作者的研究发现——this crisis had another __(27)__ cause—
    that some people in the banking sector were playing or "gaming" the system for their own
    financial gain（这场危机另有深层原因：银行从业者为私利在操纵系统）。后文逐层展开这
  场"游戏"的要素：金融产品的刻意复杂、渗透决策的行为偏差与人格特质、以及对政府兜底的
  预期；末段给出"几乎无解"的结论。抓住"银行家为私利操纵系统"这一主旨，后面 31 空（奖金
  相关）、34 空（能否终结操纵）等辨义题就有了裁判标准。





D I S T R A C T O R S · 干扰词复盘

这 5 个词始终没被任何空选用

词库 15 词里有 5 个是命题人埋的干扰词——它们词性看着也对、词义也沾点边，却不该
填进任何一个空。下面逐个剖析它们最像哪个空的答案、为什么是陷阱。




   C) fragile 冒充32空的脆弱

  它最像 32 空——"银行业某些部分对风险脆弱"中文思维完全通顺，词性也对。识破靠搭配：英语
  说 be prone / vulnerable to risk，不说 be fragile to risk；fragile 多单独作表语或修饰 system、
   economy、recovery 这类会"破碎"的实体。防坑一句话：双语感冲突时信搭配清单，不信中文
  直译。



   G) overlapping 冒充27和28空的重叠

   overlapping cause、overlapping biases 字面都能组合，在 27、28 两个空都像模像样。识破靠文本
  证据：全文没有任何"重叠、交叠"的信息，including those who are overconfident and take
   excessive risks 举的是不同类型的偏差而非互相重叠——查无此据即无中生有，直接排除。



   K) prototypes 冒充名词空的词性合格者

  作为名词，它在 29 空（personality ___）、30 空（the ___ of）都握有"词性正确"的入场券。识破靠
  语义层级：prototype 指具体产品、模型的原型，与 personality、complexity 这类抽象概念都构不
  成有效搭配——词性只是入场券，语义搭配才是座位号。

Such people tend to like complexity for its own sake, but they often do not fully
   understand the implications of that complexity for the stability of the financial
   system as a whole.

  第3段，第1句

  "转折并列句 + 长宾语后置修饰" 是四六级与考研阅读中极其高频的典范句式。掌握如何通过并列
  连词 "but" 抓住转折重点，以及如何拆解 "implications of... for..." 这一典型介词搭配结构，具有极
  高的可迁移性。



   Often they do not care—they are primarily interested in gaming the system to
  maximise their bonuses.

  第3段，第2句

  破折号表示解释说明的并列句式，以及“be interested in doing sth to do sth”的搭配在四六级和考
  研阅读中极具代表性，迁移价值高。



   There are parts of the banking sector that will always be prone to risk, but many
   bankers have come to feel immune to its potential impact, because they presume
   that, however recklessly banks behave, governments will always be there to bail
  them out.

  第4段，第2句

  综合来看，该句在嵌套复杂度和成分丰富度上表现突出，逻辑层次极其清晰且富有代表性，能有效
  训练学生剥离多层从句与定位主干的能力，属于应优先精读训练的高价值典型句子。



  The only effective measure to end it would be to make bankers personally liable for
   losses, but no government has ever passed such a law, and no single government
   could do so on its own, since this would immediately cause their entire national
   banking sector to move wholesale to another jurisdiction.

  第5段，第2句

  本句包含了不定式作后置定语、不定式作表语、"make + 宾语 + 宾补"（"liable for..."）以及 "cause
  + 宾语 + 宾补"（"to move..."）等极高频且易错的成分组合，极其适合用来训练长难句成分划分与
  分析。

                    How do you bring a forest back to life?

A) Five hundred years ago,  forests covered much of  the  Iberian  peninsula. But  that soon changed.
    Centuries of wars and invasions, agricultural expansion and woodcutting for firewood and shipping
   wiped out most of the woods and transformed places like Matamorisca, a small village in northern
    Spain, into degraded landscapes.
  五百年前，森林覆盖了伊比利亚半岛的大部分地区。但这种情况很快发生了改变。数百年的战争和入
  侵、农业扩张，以及为取暖和造船而砍伐木材，使大部分森林消失，并将西班牙北部的小村庄
  Matamorisca等地变成了退化的景观。
