    replant  trees, but for the Amsterdam-based Land Life Company  it's an ideal place. "We typically
    operate where nature does not come back by itself," says Jurrian Ruys, its CEO. "We go where there
    are rougher conditions in terms of weather, with rough or very hot summers." In Matamorisca, they
    intervened in 17 barren hectares owned by the regional government and peppered them with their
    signature device: a biodegradable(可生物降解的) cardboard container they call the cocoon which can
    hold 25  litres of water underground to aid a seedling's  first  year. Around 16,000  trees, including
    oaks, ashes, walnuts, rowans, and whitebeams, were planted in May 2018, and the company reports
    that 96%  of them  survived  that  year's  burning  hot summer  without  extra  irrigation,  a  critical
    milestone for a young tree.
  该地区干燥的气候和贫瘠的土壤，对于一般的植树造林计划来说将是灾难的根源，但对于总部位于阿
  姆斯特丹的Land Life Company而言，这里却是理想之地。该公司的首席执行官Jurrian Ruys说：“我

  他的公司属于一个全球性运动，该运动由一系列试图拯救退化或遭到砍伐的地区的组织组成，这些地

真题卷第2套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part III Section C


Directions: There   are 2 passages   in  this section.Each passage   is followed by some questions or
unfinished statements.For each  of them   there   are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should
decide  on the best choice and mark the corresponding  letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line
through the centre.

Passage One
Questions 46 to 50 are based on the following passage.

    P1 What does self-discipline look like at work? Sometimes,  it's the ability to resist temptation, such
as distractions to avoid a particular task. Other times  it's the ability to persist with a task when your
energy and motivation seem low.
在工作中，自律是什么样的表现？有时，它是抵制诱惑的能力，比如抵制那些让你逃避某项特定任务的干
扰。还有些时候，它是在精力和动力似乎都很低的时候，仍然坚持完成一项任务的能力。

    P2 What do you believe about the nature of your own self-discipline? Is  it something that runs on
internal energy that is spent with use? Or is it something that is bolstered as you apply it and persist?
你如何看待自身自律的本质？它是否依靠一种会随着使用而消耗的内在能量运行？还是说，它会在你运用
自律并坚持下去的过程中得到增强？

    P3 Your answer  matters,  as  it  determines how much  self-discipline you  experience. For  years,
research in psychology pointed to self-control as a resource that  is depleted with use and needs to be
restored through breaks,  rest, or  sleep. More  recently, however, research points  to the importance of
mindset. If you view self-discipline as an expendable resource, your willpower tends to fade with use. If
you believe  that exercising your  self-control strengthens and  fuels  it,  that  is more  likely  to be your
experience as you resist temptation or push yourself to get something done that is not appealing.
你的答案很重要，因为它决定了你能体验到多少自律。多年来，心理学研究认为，自我控制是一种会因使
用而消耗、需要通过休息、放松或睡眠来恢复的资源。然而，近来的研究更加重视思维方式的重要性。如





               懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/cet6/sections/2026-06-2/part3-section-c/?f=p · 在线使用效果更好

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第2套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
果你把自律看作一种会耗尽的资源，你的意志力往往会随着使用而减弱。如果你相信运用自我控制能够
增强并补充它，那么当你抵制诱惑，或迫使自己完成一件并不吸引人的事情时，你更有可能获得这样的
体验。

    P4  If you don't already view self-discipline as a force that feeds itself, what might you do? Reflect
on times that you had initial difficulty resisting temptation, getting started on something, or sticking with
it, but pushed ahead and accomplished the task or met the goal. That's the kind of experience we're
talking about with this particular belief about self-discipline, and you've already had such an experience,
so you've shown that  it's possible. When you feel your willpower and motivation fading, remind yourself
of those previous experiences and imagine the same happening now.
如果你还没有把自律看作一种能够自我补充的力量，可以做些什么呢？回想一下这样的时刻：起初你很难
抵制诱惑、开始做某件事，或者坚持做下去，但后来你还是继续努力，完成了任务或实现了目标。这正是
我们所说的关于自律的这种特定信念所对应的经历，而你已经有过这样的经历，所以你已经证明了这是可
能的。当你感到意志力和动力逐渐消退时，提醒自己想起以往的这些经历，并想象现在也会发生同样的
情况。

    P5 What  if your experiences have always seemed to indicate that your self-control diminishes with
use, and you need breaks to recharge? There's nothing wrong with that as long as you can afford to take
those breaks. If not, remind yourself that not everyone experiences self-discipline as a depletable resource
and that your experience might be different  if you focus on gathering more energy at this point rather
than focusing on how difficult it is to continue or the need for a break.
如果你的经历一直表明，你的自我控制会随着使用而减弱，需要通过休息来充电，那该怎么办？只要你有
条件休息，这本身没有什么问题。如果没有条件，那么就提醒自己，并非每个人都会把自律体验为一种会
耗尽的资源；如果此时你把注意力放在积蓄更多能量上，而不是关注继续下去有多么困难或认为自己需要
休息，你的体验可能会有所不同。

    P6 Also,  if you know someone who is a role model of self-discipline, picture that person in your
situation,  persisting  in  the  task. Regardless of how you do  it, as you push forward  to continue  to
accomplish progress, be sure to mentally reinforce yourself by taking pride in your ability to exert more
willpower as you persist.
此外，如果你认识一位自律方面的榜样，可以想象那个人处在你的情境中，坚持完成这项任务。无论你采
用什么方式，当你继续向前、不断取得进展时，一定要通过为自己能够在坚持过程中发挥出更强的意志力
而感到自豪，在心理上不断强化自己。

    P7 The benefits of exerting willpower are cumulative. Your self-discipline is akin to a muscle, and
each time you  resist temptation or persist in a task despite a lack of motivation, you strengthen that
muscle, leading to less effort and resistance in similar instances in the future.
发挥意志力所带来的益处会不断累积。你的自律就像一块肌肉，每当你抵制诱惑，或在缺乏动力的情况下
仍坚持完成一项任务时，你都会锻炼并强化这块肌肉，从而使自己在今后遇到类似情况时付出更少的努
力，也能减少阻力。

46. What plays an important role in determining how much self-discipline people experience?

   A) Their belief about the nature of motivation.

   B) Their use of internal energy for persisting.

   C) Their conception of self-discipline.

   D) Their ability to resist temptation.

什么在决定人们所能体验到的自律程度方面发挥着重要作用？

A) 他们对动机本质的看法。  B) 他们为坚持下去而使用内在能量的方式。  C) 他们对自律的理解。

D) 他们抵制诱惑的能力。
【答案】C （细节题）

【判型】What plays an important role in determining...询问的是某一结果的决定因素，属于'某事
     由什么造成'的事实定位型提问。

【拆句】What plays an important role in determining how much self-discipline people
      experience?是主谓宾结构：what作主语，plays作谓语，an important role作宾语，in
     determining...作后置定语修饰role。整体语法平铺直叙，无否定或比较陷阱。

【定位】Your answer matters, as it determines how much self-discipline you experience.

    你的答案很重要，因为它决定了你体验到多少自律。

【选项】A) 偷换概念
        选项把原文关于self-discipline本性的信念，偷换成了about the nature of
        motivation，属于概念替换。

        B) 偷换概念
              'internal energy'只是人们可能持有的一种信念内容，不是决定自律体验的因素本身。

        C) ✓ 正确
            Your answer matters ↔Their conception of self-discipline
             determines how much self-discipline you experience ↔

             plays an important role in determining how much self-discipline people experience
            Their conception of self-discipline对应'你对self-discipline本性的回答/信念'，与定位
      句完全贴合。

        D) 答非所问
       抵抗诱惑是self-discipline的一种表现形式，而不是决定人们体验到多少自律的因素。


47. What did years of research suggest about self-discipline?

   A) It is a depletable resource.

   B) It is bolstered through use.

   C) Its strength is dependent on willpower.

   D) Its exercise is an exhausting experience.

多年的研究表明，自律具有什么特点？

A) 它是一种可以耗竭的资源。  B) 它会通过使用得到增强。  C) 它的强度取决于意志力。

D) 运用它是一种令人精疲力竭的经历。
【答案】A （细节题）

【判型】What did years of research suggest about self-discipline?直接询问过去研究的观点，属
    于事实细节题。

【拆句】What did years of research suggest about self-discipline?是特殊疑问句，主语为years
         of research，谓语为suggest，about self-discipline为介词短语。无复杂从句或否定
    结构。

【定位】For years, research in psychology pointed to self-control as a resource that is depleted with
         use and needs to be restored through breaks, rest, or sleep.

     多年来，心理学研究把self-control视为一种会随使用而耗尽、需要通过休息、睡眠来恢复
    的资源。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确
             a resource that is depleted with use ↔It is a depletable resource

                  It is a depletable resource准确对应a resource that is depleted with use。

        B) 与原文相反
       这是较新研究/积极信念的观点，不是'years of research'早期研究的结论。

        C) 无中生有
         原文并未说self-control的强度dependent on willpower，二者在这里几乎是同义
      循环。

        D) 过度推断
       原文说需要休息恢复，不等于说使用体验是'exhausting experience'（令人筋疲力尽的
      经历）。


48. Why does the author ask us to reflect on our experience of meeting the goal despite initial difficulty?

   A) To show the urgency of abandoning outdated beliefs about self-control.

   B) To show the feasibility of viewing self-discipline as a force fueling itself.

   C) To support the argument for persistence in workplace accomplishments.

   D) To add evidence to consistent findings in previous psychological research.

尽管一开始困难重重却最终实现目标，作者为什么要求我们回想这样的经历？

A) 说明摒弃关于自我控制的过时观念的紧迫性。

B) 说明将自律视为一种能够自我提供动力的力量是可行的。  C) 支持在工作成就方面坚持不懈的观点。

D) 为以往心理学研究中的一致发现增添证据。
【答案】B （细节题）

【判型】Why does the author ask us to reflect on...虽含why，但仍是就文中具体建议的意图提
    问，答案可在该建议句附近找到，归为细节题而非推断题。

         despite initial difficulty?中，why问目的，主句为the author asks us to reflect on...，
         of meeting the goal despite initial difficulty为experience的后置定语。无否定或比较
    结构。

【定位】Reflect on times that you had initial difficulty resisting temptation, getting started on
         something, or sticking with it, but pushed ahead and accomplished the task or met the goal.
          That's the kind of experience we're talking about with this particular belief about self-
           discipline, and you've already had such an experience, so you've shown that it's possible.

    回想那些你起初难以抵制诱惑、难以开始或难以坚持，但最终推进并完成任务或达成目标的
    时刻。这正是我们所说的关于自律的那种特定信念所对应的体验，而且你已经有过这样的体
    验，所以你已证明这是可能的。

【选项】A) 过度推断
        原文并未说要'abandon outdated beliefs'，只是建议补充一种积极信念，没有
           urgency 或彻底抛弃旧信念的意思。

        B) ✓ 正确

               That's the kind of experience we're talking about with this particular belief about self-discipline

          ↔viewing self-discipline as a force fueling itself

   A) Figure out what has gone wrong.

   B) Focus on the hardest part of our task.

   C) Exert ourselves to go on with the work.

如果我们无法抽出时间休息来恢复精力，建议我们怎么做？

A) 弄清楚哪里出了问题。  B) 专注于任务中最困难的部分。  C) 使出全力继续工作。

D) 从身边的人那里汲取新的能量。
【答案】C （细节题）

【判型】What are we advised to do if we cannot afford to take breaks to recharge?询问在特

   A) The more it is applied, the more resistance it encounters.

text:
For years, research in psychology pointed to self-control as a resource that is
depleted with use and needs to be restored through breaks, rest, or sleep.

第3段，第2句

"Research pointed to A as B that..." 是学术阅读与各类英语考试中极高频出现的阐述研究观点和定
义概念的典型句式，掌握后复用价值高。



If you view self-discipline as an expendable resource, your willpower tends to fade
with use.

第3段，第4句

"If" 引导的条件主从复合句以及 "view A as B"、"tend to do" 等习惯搭配在各类英语考试阅读中频
繁出现，具有极高的句式代表性与教学迁移价值。



If you believe that exercising your self-control strengthens and fuels it, that is
more likely to be your experience as you resist temptation or push yourself to get
something done that is not appealing.

第3段，第5句

“条件从句 + 主句 + 状语从句（含定语从句）”是英语议论文和四六级、考研阅读真题中极其典型
的长难句句式，掌握后复用迁移价值极高。



If you don't already view self-discipline as a force that feeds itself, what might you
do?

第4段，第1句

“If 从句 + 情态动词疑问句”是四六级与考研阅读中高频出现的引导式句型，嵌套定语从句修饰名词
的做法也非常典型，具有极高的可迁移学习价值。



Reflect on times that you had initial difficulty resisting temptation, getting started
on something, or sticking with it, but pushed ahead and accomplished the task or
met the goal.

第4段，第2句

句式结构呈现典型的“祈使句 + 定语从句 + 多重并列谓语”，非常符合大学英语四六级及考研英语
写作与阅读分析的常见范式，迁移应用价值极高。

text:
When you feel your willpower and motivation fading, remind yourself of those
previous experiences and imagine the same happening now.

第4段，第4句

本句包含了祈使句的主语隐去、并列谓语结构、感官动词与心理动词后的“宾语+现在分词补足语”
搭配，以及句首时间状语从句，是练习划分复合成分与区分谓语与非谓语动词的优质素材。



What if your experiences have always seemed to indicate that your self-control
diminishes with use, and you need breaks to recharge?

第5段，第1句

“What if...”引导的假设句以及“seem to do that...”的表达在四六级与考研阅读中高频出现，掌握该句
型的层级拆解与省略还原具有极高的迁移价值。



There's nothing wrong with that as long as you can afford to take those breaks.

第5段，第2句

句中 'There be' 结构、'as long as' 引导条件状语从句以及 'afford to do' 搭配均为四六级与考研真
题中的高频典型句式。



If not, remind yourself that not everyone experiences self-discipline as a
depletable resource and that your experience might be different if you focus on
gathering more energy at this point rather than focusing on how difficult it is to
continue or the need for a break.

第5段，第3句

综合来看，虽然时态语态难度适中，但其嵌套层级深、语法考点密集且结构极具代表性，是非常优
质的长难句结构分析训练材料。



Also, if you know someone who is a role model of self-discipline, picture that
person in your situation, persisting in the task.

第6段，第1句

包含“条件从句 + 祈使句主句”的标准写作句式，配合定语从句修饰与分词补足结构，是四六级与考
研阅读及写作中的高度典型句型。

progress, be sure to mentally reinforce yourself by taking pride in your ability to
exert more willpower as you persist.

第6段，第2句

这种“前置状语/让步成分 + 祈使主句 + 多重非谓语修饰”的结构在四六级和考研阅读的励志与心理

What plays an important role in determining how much self-discipline people
experience?

第46题题干

Its strength is dependent on willpower.

第47题，C

"主语 + 系动词 + 形容词 + 介词短语" 是英语中最常见的高频主系表句式之一，具有极强的代表性
和复用价值。



Why does the author ask us to reflect on our experience of meeting the goal
despite initial difficulty?

第48题题干

“Why does the author ask...”是各类英语考试阅读理解题干中最典型的提问句型之一，结构高度标

Q U E S T I O N S  &  A N A L Y S I S · 阅读理解题和解析

阅读理解题和解析 · 51–55 题

本页 51–55 题的答案与逐题解析由懒笔记基于2026年6月·第2套 英语六级阅读理解（四选
一）原卷逐题核对整理。与试卷排版同一卷面：先是 Directions 与 8 段原文（段首标 P1–
P8 段号、逐段附中文翻译）；之后 5 道题逐题排列，每题英文题干与选项后紧接本题
解析——题干与选项中译、答案、题型判定、题干拆句、定位句中英对照与逐选项对错
归因。



真题卷第2套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part III Section C (2)


Directions: There   are 2 passages   in  this section.Each passage   is followed by some questions or
unfinished statements.For each  of them   there   are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should
decide  on the best choice and mark the corresponding  letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line
through the centre.

Passage Two
Questions 51 to 55 are based on the following passage.

    P1 Smartphones have always posed challenges  for parents of  teens. From  social media apps  to
excessive screen time, the digital world is as threatening as the physical.
智能手机一直给青少年父母带来挑战。从社交媒体应用到过度使用屏幕，数字世界和现实世界一样具有威
胁性。

    P2 A new study shows  that about  half of parents of teens are worried about  their teens being
exposed to explicit content online. This is a valid concern, of course. But there are ways to alleviate the
spread of explicit content, from changing the settings in their kids' phone to monitoring such content
with apps like Bark.
一项新的研究显示，大约一半的青少年父母担心自己的孩子会在网上接触到露骨内容。当然，这种担忧是
合理的。但是，有一些方法可以减缓露骨内容的传播，比如更改孩子手机中的设置，或使用 Bark 等应用
监控这类内容。

    P3  Just as alarming,  if not more so,  is that the amount of time teens spend on social media can
lead to anxiety and depression.
同样令人担忧，甚至更加令人担忧的是，青少年花在社交媒体上的时间可能会导致焦虑和抑郁。

    P4 Excessive screen time has  detrimental  effects,  for a  lot of obvious  reasons. Constant media
consumption inhibits healthy activities associated with childhood, like spending time outside, exercising,





               懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/cet6/sections/2026-06-2/part3-section-c-2/?f=p · 在线使用效果更好

file: 补充资料_2026年6月\2026年06月六级解析第2套_懒笔记整理版.pdf
text:
talking to friends and family. If it interferes with sleep, that's even worse.
过度使用屏幕会产生不利影响，原因有很多，而且显而易见。持续接触媒体会妨碍童年时期与健康相关的
活动，例如待在户外、锻炼以及与朋友和家人交谈。如果它还干扰睡眠，那就更糟糕了。

    P5 Ample research shows too much smartphone use produces significant anxiety, depression, and
feelings  of  isolation  in  teens. Teens  log on  to  social media  or spend time  online  trying  to make
connections, but end up feeling more alone and sad than ever. Faceless communication not only produces
feelings  of  isolation and  loneliness  but  increases  instances  of  online  bullying and  susceptibility  to
criminal conducts.
大量研究表明，过度使用智能手机会使青少年产生严重的焦虑、抑郁和孤立感。青少年登录社交媒体或上
网，试图建立联系，但最终却比以往任何时候都感到更加孤独和悲伤。无面对面的交流不仅会产生孤立感
和孤独感，还会增加网络欺凌事件以及受犯罪行为影响的可能性。

    P6 Though I've banned most social media, I've  still battled smartphone time with my own kids. A
lot of the time  I wish  I could throw my kids' smartphones into the nearest lake. The convenience of
communication—when they need a ride home from school after practice, for instance—often feels like  it
isn't worth the battle to keep their screen time low and productive, and continue to encourage "real-life"
activities outside and with friends and family. I understand the addiction and often tell them I'm not sure
how I would have handled having a smartphone as a teen. As an adult, I too, struggle with overuse.
虽然我已经禁止使用大多数社交媒体，但我仍然一直在和自己的孩子争论使用智能手机的时间。很多时
候，我真希望能把孩子们的智能手机扔进最近的湖里。通信的便利性——比如他们课外活动结束后需要搭
车回家时——常常让人觉得，为了控制他们的屏幕使用时间，使其保持较低水平并发挥积极作用，同时继
续鼓励他们在户外以及与朋友和家人进行“现实生活”活动，并不值得这样争斗。我理解这种成瘾，而且常
常告诉他们，我不知道自己在青少年时期拥有一部智能手机会如何应对。作为一个成年人，我也在努力应
对过度使用的问题。

    P7 In a recent TV interview to promote a new film about a mother and daughter navigating social
media use, actress Kate Winslet expressed her view on teens and social media—and her concern mirrors
the trends. "I do definitely feel that the world of social media is frightening to parents because we don't
really know what's there," she said. "We don't know how our children are using  it. We don't know the
effects that it's really having on them."
在最近一次为宣传一部讲述母女共同应对社交媒体使用问题的新电影而进行的电视采访中，女演员凯特·温
斯莱特表达了她对青少年和社交媒体的看法，而她的担忧与相关趋势相一致。她说：“我确实觉得，社交
媒体的世界令父母感到害怕，因为我们并不真正知道那里有什么。我们不知道自己的孩子是如何使用它
的。我们不知道它究竟会对他们产生什么影响。”

    P8  I don't think the U.S. government should regulate social media and teen smartphone use, but  it
is a vital topic for parents to understand and take seriously. Unfortunately, now, parents don't just have to
worry about real-world dangers, but all the ones sneaking online and the effects they have on teenagers
and their mental health.
我认为美国政府不应监管社交媒体和青少年使用智能手机的问题，但这是一个父母必须了解并认真对待的
重要话题。遗憾的是，如今父母不仅要担心现实世界中的危险，还要担心所有悄悄潜入网络的危险，以及
这些危险对青少年及其心理健康造成的影响。

text:
51. What do around half of parents of teens do according to a new study?

   A) They set their kids' phones to filter out obscene information.

   B) They try to alleviate the spread of explicit scenes on the internet.

   C) They feel concerned about their kids' viewing indecent content online.

   D) They strive to prevent their kids from spending excessive screen time.

根据一项新研究，大约一半有青少年的父母会做什么？

A) 他们将孩子的手机设置为过滤淫秽信息。  B) 他们试图减缓互联网上露骨场景的传播。

C) 他们担心孩子在网上观看不雅内容。  D) 他们努力防止孩子花费过多时间看屏幕。
【答案】C （细节题）

【判型】题干What do around half of parents of teens do according to a new study?询问研究
    中的具体事实，属于对单一信息的直接考查。

【拆句】主干为What do...parents do，according to a new study为介词短语作状语，说明信息来
    源。整体是简单疑问句，无否定、比较等陷阱。

【定位】A new study shows that about half of parents of teens are worried about their teens being
         exposed to explicit content online.

    一项新研究显示，约半数青少年父母担心自己的孩子在网上接触露骨内容。

【选项】A) 偷换概念：措施≠已实施行为
         A项They set their kids' phones to filter out obscene information.把第二段中
           changing the settings这类可能的缓解措施，说成是父母已经采取的行动，而原文并未
      说半数父母已这样做。

        B) 偷换概念：可能性≠实际行为
         B项They try to alleviate the spread of explicit scenes on the internet.把原文there
            are ways to alleviate the spread（存在缓解途径）替换为父母try to alleviate（正在
      尝试缓解），改变了行为主体与事实状态。

        C) ✓ 正确
             worried ↔concerned
             being exposed to explicit content online ↔viewing indecent content online
         C项They feel concerned about their kids' viewing indecent content online.准确对
        应定位句中父母worried about孩子being exposed to explicit content online。

        D) 答非所问：跨段混用话题
         D项They strive to prevent their kids from spending excessive screen time.将第三
        段以后才出现的excessive screen time话题嫁接到第二段关于explicit content的研究结
      论上，答非所问。

text:
52. What does a large amount of research show about teens' excessive smartphone use?

   A) It allows them less time for meaningful activities.

   B) It renders them more lonely and low-spirited.

   C) It gives them less time for social interactions.

   D) It makes them more alert to online bullying.

大量研究显示，青少年过度使用智能手机会造成什么影响？

A) 这使他们用于有意义活动的时间减少。  B) 这使他们更加孤独和情绪低落。

C) 这使他们用于社交活动的时间减少。  D) 这使他们更加警觉网络欺凌。
【答案】B （细节题）

【判型】题干What does a large amount of research show about teens' excessive smartphone
     use?要求找出研究所示的具体结果。

【拆句】主干为What...research show，about teens' excessive smartphone use为介词短语限定
    范围。无复杂从句或否定。

【定位】Ample research shows too much smartphone use produces significant anxiety, depression,
        and feelings of isolation in teens. Teens log on to social media or spend time online trying to
       make connections, but end up feeling more alone and sad than ever.

    大量研究表明，过度使用智能手机会给青少年带来严重的焦虑、抑郁和孤独感。青少年登录
    社交媒体或上网试图建立联系，但最终感到比以往更加孤独和悲伤。

【选项】A) 偷换概念：上位/下位词替换失当
          A项It allows them less time for meaningful activities.把第四段healthy activities
            associated with childhood, like spending time outside, exercising, talking to
            friends and family中的healthy activities替换为meaningful activities，缩小并改变了
      概念范围。

        B) ✓ 正确
               feeling more alone ↔lonely
             sad ↔low-spirited
               feelings of isolation ↔lonely
          B项It renders them more lonely and low-spirited.准确概括了定位句中more alone
          and sad than ever及feelings of isolation的含义。

        C) 与原文相反：行为方向矛盾
          C项It gives them less time for social interactions.说减少了社交时间，但原文Teens
           log on to social media or spend time online trying to make connections说明青少
      年反而花更多时间在网上进行社交尝试。

        D) 偷换概念：结果→主体态度
          D项It makes them more alert to online bullying.把原文increases instances of

D) 这种看法很复杂，兼具正反两面。
【答案】D （态度题）

【判型】题干What do we learn about the author's feelings regarding smartphones and
        screen time?直接询问作者对某事物的情感态度。

【拆句】主干为What do we learn about the author's feelings，regarding smartphones and
        screen time为介词短语说明对象。无复杂结构。

【选项】A) 以偏概全：只取单一态度信号
         A项They are deep-seated.（根深蒂固的）只呼应了作者对智能手机问题的强烈反感，
      但忽略了作者承认便利和理解上瘾的部分。

        B) 偷换概念：情感强烈≠本能
         B项They are instinctive.（本能的）将作者对智能手机的厌恶理解为本能反应，但原文
      明确给出了理性原因（屏幕时间、通讯便利等），并非单纯本能。

        C) 无中生有
         C项They are unique.（独特的）在原文中没有任何对应信息，作者反而说I understand
           the addiction，暗示这种感受具有普遍性。

        D) ✓ 正确

                  I wish I could throw my kids' smartphones into the nearest lake. The convenience of
              communication...often feels like it isn't worth the battle...I understand the addiction...I too,
               struggle with overuse.

         ↔mixed
         D项They are mixed.用一词概括了第六段中作者既反感又理解、既看到弊端又承认便利
      的复杂情感。

From social media apps to excessive screen time, the digital world is as
threatening as the physical.

第1段，第2句

"From... to..." 引导范围状语结合 "as... as..." 同级比较是各类考试阅读中极高频出现的说明型句式，
具有很强的模式复用价值。



A new study shows that about half of parents of teens are worried about their
teens being exposed to explicit content online.

第2段，第1句

“研究/调查指出 + that 宾语从句”是四六级与考研阅读及写作中高频出现的经典句式，具有极高的
句式迁移价值。



Just as alarming, if not more so, is that the amount of time teens spend on social
media can lead to anxiety and depression.

第3段，第1句

综合来看，该句时态较为基础，但倒装与嵌套结构极具代表性和训练价值，能有效帮助学生突破
“表语前置”和“从句嵌套”两大阅读障碍，建议优先作为重点训练材料。



Faceless communication not only produces feelings of isolation and loneliness but
increases instances of online bullying and susceptibility to criminal conducts.

第5段，第3句

"not only ... but" 连接并列谓语是四六级与考研阅读中极常见的句式结构，具有很高的迁移与复用
价值。



Though I've banned most social media, I've still battled smartphone time with my
own kids.

第6段，第1句

"Though + 让步状语从句, 主句" 是各类英语考试中极高频考查的对比让步句式，结构典型且复用价

A lot of the time I wish I could throw my kids' smartphones into the nearest lake.

第6段，第2句

包含动词 "wish" 后接虚拟语气宾语从句的典型结构，是各类英语考试中常见的经典句式。



The convenience of communication—when they need a ride home from school
after practice, for instance—often feels like it isn't worth the battle to keep their
screen time low and productive, and continue to encourage "real-life" activities
outside and with friends and family.

第6段，第3句

本句呈现了长难句中非常典型的“主谓分隔 + 从句嵌套 + 形式主语 + 并列非谓语”结构，是四六级
与考研阅读中极具代表性的高频句式。



I understand the addiction and often tell them I'm not sure how I would have
handled having a smartphone as a teen.

第6段，第4句

动词带双宾语嵌套从句以及 "would have done" 虚拟语气是四六级与考研真题中的高频考点句式，
结构极具代表性。



In a recent TV interview to promote a new film about a mother and daughter
navigating social media use, actress Kate Winslet expressed her view on teens and
social media—and her concern mirrors the trends.

第7段，第1句

句中集中展示了不定式作目的状语、分词短语作后置定语、长介词短语背景状语以及破折号并列句
的识别，非常适合训练剥离修饰成分、提炼句子主干的能力。



"I do definitely feel that the world of social media is frightening to parents because
we don't really know what's there," she said.

第7段，第2句

本句覆盖了强调谓语（"do feel"）、主系表结构（"is frightening"）、介词短语做状语补足语（"to
parents"）以及从句在不同层级充当宾语和状语的丰富成分，非常适合作为划分复杂句成分的综合
训练材料。

真题卷第2套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part IV


Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English.
You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.

  电子商务的蓬勃发展正在深刻改变中国农村的面貌。随着互联网和物流网络快速向农村延伸， 越
来越多的农村居民通过电子商务平台将农产品直接销售给城市消费者。近年来，直播带货 ( live-
streaming commerce) 使城市消费者能够与卖家实时互动，已成为促进农村发展的一种新方式。电子商
务打破了城乡之间的信息壁垒，拓宽了农产品销售渠道，帮助农村居民增收致富。数字经济与乡村振
兴的深度融合，正在为中国农村发展注入前所未有的活力。


参考译文

正确」四档评分。

    The booming development of e-commerce  is profoundly changing the face of rural China. As the

Internet and logistics networks rapidly extend into rural areas, more and more rural residents are selling

their agricultural products directly to urban consumers through e-commerce platforms. In recent years,

live-streaming commerce, which  enables urban consumers  to  interact  with  sellers  in  real  time,  has

become a new way to promote rural development. E-commerce has broken down the information barriers

between urban and  rural  areas and expanded  sales  channels  for  agricultural  products,  helping  rural

residents increase their incomes and achieve prosperity. The deep integration of the digital economy with

text:
【衔接】句2→句3：用时间线自然衔接

     句2讲「随着……延伸」的背景趋势，句3以近年来推进到最新现象，英文保留 In recent years 置于
     句首，两句之间形成「背景→新进展」的时间递进，无需额外关联词，靠时间状语即完成衔接。

    句4主语重复「电子商务」的处理
     电子商务在句1、句4两次作主语，因中间隔了两句、指代链已断，句4不宜用代词 it（会让读者回
     头找错对象），直接重复 E-commerce 反而清楚；句4内部用 helping 分词承接结果，避免 and
     三连。

     句5收束：与句1进行时首尾呼应

     句1「正在深刻改变」与句5「正在为中国农村发展注入前所未有的活力」都用现在进行时（is
        changing / is injecting），一开头一收尾形成闭环，末句无需加 In short 之类总结词，时态一致
     本身就是连贯信号。


逐句解析
一整段连排中文、无段落标记无题号——把它切成一句句翻译单元本身就是解题动作，句前 N. 为逐句解析自切的
句序号（非考卷题号），与卷面中文逐字对应。

【主旨】中国农村电商发展现状介绍

     整段围绕电子商务的蓬勃发展正在深刻改变中国农村的面貌展开，逐句铺陈电商进农村、直播带
     货、城乡信息壁垒被打破、数字经济与乡村振兴融合等事实。这是典型的六级汉译英语体：对中国
     社会经济发展成就的客观介绍，属说明性语体，用词应正式、平实，不抒情、不口语。

【时态】一般现在时

     全段是在陈述当下正在发生的客观趋势：正在深刻改变、正在为中国农村发展注入前所未有的活力
     用的是进行体，打破了城乡之间的信息壁垒、已成为促进农村发展的一种新方式是已完成的结果。
     以一般现在时为默认骨架，凡带「正在」的句子用现在进行时、带「了/已成为/近年来」的句子用
     现在完成时，这三者同属「现在」时间域，基调统一、不算飘忽。

【译法】电子商务

     统一译作 e-commerce（全篇词根一致，动词义用 e-commerce platforms 表「电子商务平
     台」）。电子商务在句1与句4两次出现，必须前后同一译法，切忌一处 e-commerce、一处
          electronic commerce 混用。

    直播带货
     原文已随文给出注释，直接采用 live-streaming commerce（直播带货），不要再自造 live
          selling 等说法；给定注释就用给定译名是六级汉译英的送分纪律。

    农产品
     统一译作 agricultural products。农产品在句2、句4出现两次，全篇只用这一个译法，不与 farm
        produce 混用。

    乡村振兴

     译作 rural revitalization（约定俗成的官方译名，乡村振兴），与「中国农村」的 rural China、
     「农村发展」的 rural development 保持 rural 一词贯通。

    数字经济
     译作 the digital economy（数字经济），economy 此处作特指概念用定冠词 the。

1. 电子商务的蓬勃发展正在深刻改变中国农村的面貌。

【主干】发展正在改变面貌（主语策略：原句主语）

     中文核心动词是改变，做这动作的是电子商务的蓬勃发展，承受对象是「中国农村的面貌」。英文
     主干立为 The development is changing the face：主语 The booming development of e-
      commerce，谓语 is changing（进行时呼应「正在」），宾语 the face of rural China。

【降级】两个「的」字修饰后置

     主干之外的修饰全是「的」字结构：电子商务的作「发展」的定语→后置介词短语 of e-
     commerce；「中国农村的」作「面貌」的定语→后置 of rural China；「蓬勃」「深刻」分别译
     作形容词 booming 与副词 profoundly，直接贴在被修饰词旁。全句无需从句，把定语从名词前
     搬到名词后即可。

【语法】时态

     「正在改变」用现在进行时 is changing——它属于全篇「现在」时间域，与基调一致，是基允许
     内的偏离，不要写成一般现在时 changes（丢了「正在」的进行义）。

    单复数与冠词
        development 表抽象「发展」不可数，用单数不加复数；face 此处特指中国农村的面貌，用 the
         face。rural China 是固定表达，China 前不加 the。

    主谓一致

     主语中心词是 development（单数），谓语用 is changing，不要被紧随其后的 of e-commerce
     带偏。

【译文】The booming development of e-commerce is profoundly changing the face of

         rural China.

2. 随着互联网和物流网络快速向农村延伸， 越来越多的农村居民通过电子商务平台将农产品直
接销售给城市消费者。

【主干】居民销售农产品（主语策略：原句主语）

     逗号后的主句才是全句重心：越来越多的农村居民通过电子商务平台将农产品直接销售给城市消费
      者。核心动词「销售」→sell；主语「农村居民」→rural residents；宾语「农产品」
         →agricultural products；「城市消费者」是间接对象→to urban consumers。主干：rural
          residents sell agricultural products to urban consumers。

【降级】「随着」降为背景状语从句

     随着互联网和物流网络快速向农村延伸是全句背景→降级为 As 引导的时间/背景状语从句 As the
          Internet and logistics networks rapidly extend into rural areas；通过电子商务平台表方式→介
     词短语 through e-commerce platforms 作状语；「直接」→副词 directly 修饰 sell。主干之外
     三块各有归处，不用 and 平铺。

text:
【语法】单复数

     「居民」「消费者」都是泛指的一类人，用复数 rural residents、urban consumers；logistics
        networks 与 e-commerce platforms 同为泛指复数；Internet 表「互联网」惯用 the Internet。

    时态
     主句可理解为主正在发生的趋势，用现在进行时 are selling 呼应全篇「现在」域；As 从句表伴随
     背景，用一般现在时 extend 即可。

    搭配

     「把某物卖给某人」用 sell sth. to sb.，to 不可省；「延伸到农村」用 extend into rural areas，
          into 表进入方向。

【译文】As the Internet and logistics networks rapidly extend into rural areas, more and

       more rural residents are selling their agricultural products directly to urban

        consumers through e-commerce platforms.

3. 近年来，直播带货 ( live- streaming commerce) 使城市消费者能够与卖家实时互动，已成为促进
农村发展的一种新方式。

【主干】直播带货已成为新方式（主语策略：原句主语）

     本句一个主语带两个动作：使城市消费者能够与卖家实时互动与已成为促进农村发展的一种新
     方式。判断语义重心在后者（下结论），故主干取 live-streaming commerce has become
        a new way：主语沿用原文给定译名 live-streaming commerce，谓语 has become，表语 a
       new way。

【降级】「使……」降级为定语从句
     使城市消费者能够与卖家实时互动降级为 which 引导的非限定定语从句 which enables urban
        consumers to interact with sellers in real time，插回主语之后；「促进农村发展的」修饰
     way→后置不定式 to promote rural development；近年来→句首时间状语 In recent years。

【语法】时态

     近年来＋「已成为」是现在完成时的双重标志，谓语用 has become；这是对基调的合理偏离，不
     能用一般现在时 becomes（丢了「至今已成」的完成义）。

    主谓一致

     主语 live-streaming commerce 是单数概念，谓语用 has become；定语从句内 which 指代它，
     从句谓语用 enables。

    搭配
      「与某人实时互动」interact with sb. in real time，in real time 是固定搭配无冠词；「一种新方
     式」a new way to do sth.，way 后接不定式。

【译文】In recent years, live-streaming commerce, which enables urban consumers

          to interact with sellers in real time, has become a new way to promote

         rural development.

4. 电子商务打破了城乡之间的信息壁垒，拓宽了农产品销售渠道，帮助农村居民增收致富。

【主干】电商打破壁垒、拓宽渠道（主语策略：原句主语）

     主语电子商务带三个动作：打破、拓宽、帮助。前两个「打破了城乡之间的信息壁垒」「拓宽了农
     产品销售渠道」是并列的核心成果，可作共用同一主语的并列谓语 has broken down ... and
        expanded ...；「帮助……」是这两个成果带来的结果，留给下一步降级。

【降级】结果动作降为分词

     帮助农村居民增收致富是前两动作带来的结果→现在分词短语 helping rural residents increase
          their incomes and achieve prosperity 作结果状语；「城乡之间的」修饰壁垒→between urban
        and rural areas 后置；「农产品销售渠道」→sales channels for agricultural products，
     渠道用 for 短语后置修饰。四字格「增收致富」拆开意译为 increase their incomes and
         achieve prosperity。

【语法】时态

     两个「了」均表已完成且影响延续至今，用现在完成时 has broken down ... and expanded ...，
     共用一个 has；分词 helping 无时态问题。

    单复数
          barriers 与 channels 均为泛指复数；incomes 指众居民各自的收入，用复数。

    搭配

      「打破壁垒」break down the barriers 为惯用搭配；「城乡之间」between urban and rural
       areas；「增收」increase one's incomes，one's 与 rural residents 对应为 their。

【译文】E-commerce has broken down the information barriers between urban and rural

         areas and expanded sales channels for agricultural products, helping rural residents

         increase their incomes and achieve prosperity.

5. 数字经济与乡村振兴的深度融合，正在为中国农村发展注入前所未有的活力。

【主干】融合正在注入活力（主语策略：原句主语）

     核心动词注入→is injecting；发出动作的主语是「数字经济与乡村振兴的深度融合」这个整体名词
      短语→The deep integration of the digital economy with rural revitalization；宾语「活力」
      →vitality；「为中国农村发展」表受益方向→into China's rural development。主干：The deep
          integration is injecting vitality into China's rural development。

【降级】本就是单主干句，修饰后置即可
     本句中文本身只有一个谓语「注入」，无需降级从句：「数字经济与乡村振兴的」→后置 of the
           digital economy with rural revitalization；「深度」→形容词 deep 前置修饰 integration；
      「前所未有的」→unprecedented 前置修饰 vitality；「为中国农村发展」→介词短语 into
         China's rural development 表注入方向。

                                     It's never too early to teach children about money

A) The cost of a mortgage or rents, meeting monthly  utility  bills, paying for a new car—all headaches most
    people get to worry about from their 20s. But while some may struggle to pay their bills after a few too
   many nights out at the start of the month, others will have a tightly followed plan for their repayments. So
   what is the difference between the shrewd saver and the more reckless spender?

B) Experts believe  it is all about the age you learn how to spend responsibly. Adult money habits are typically
    set by the age of seven, according to a large-scale study by the government's Money Advice Service and
    behaviour experts at Cambridge University. By then, most children have grasped how to recognise the value
    of money and are capable of complex functions such as planning ahead, delaying a decision until later and
    understanding that some choices are irreversible.

C) Tomorrow marks  the  start  of Global Money Week, a worldwide  initiative  to help  children make smart
    financial decisions and learn  that "money matters matter". But for many young people in the UK,  it's a
    matter of too  little, too  late. "The  habits of mind which influence the ways children approach complex
   problems and decisions, including financial ones, are largely determined in the  first few years of life," says
   Dr David Whitebread, the co-author of the study. And this core behaviour  is very likely to influence their
    financial decisions when they are adults, he says.

text:
D) The study also urges parents not  to underestimate  their own good and bad money  habits. "Since young
    children have few monetary resources they control independently,  it is the basic approaches and skills which
    are modelled, discussed and demonstrated by parents that are likely to be influential levers, breeding efficient
    habits and practices," it says.

E) Parents who choose to help their children learn how to plan ahead, reflect on the past and self-regulate can
   make a huge difference in promoting good financial behaviour in the future, explains Whitebread. According
    to a survey by M&G Investments, the vast majority (83%) of parents recognise the value of teaching their
    children about money. However, this concern does not always carry through to practice—one in six do not
    feel confident enough to do  it. More than one in every four parents think children should take responsibility
    for understanding money themselves.

F) "There's joy in the fact that young children are spontaneous and live  life in the moment, unrestrained by
    adult problems. But teaching children about money when they are young is a good way for parents to help
   them learn to delay  satisfaction, so  that the child thinks:  'I'd  like to do  this but I'm not going  to'. Hard
   evidence suggests,  if you want your child to do well in  life, the earlier you can start trying to teach them
    inhibition and  self-discipline, the  better," says Whitebread, pointing  to research  that has shown people  in
   prison frequently have poor impulse control, a personality  trait  that can affect relationships and long-term
    health.

G) But how should a parent try to teach  their child to spend responsibly? One simple way  is to give them
    pocket money and then help them to analyse and learn from any foolish spending decisions.

H) Another is through board games which can help teach financial responsibility. Pop to the Shops, a shopping
    board game for five-to-nine-year-olds, has been one of Orchard Toys' top 10 bestselling board games every
    year for the past 15 years. To win, players must use fake coins to purchase everyday grocery items from
    various shops around the board, and give the other players who visit their shop the correct change. If they
    don't have enough money, they must purchase a cheaper item. "It acts as a conversation starter about money
   —parents can fill in the gaps," says Orchard Toys product manager Rachael Sutcliffe.

I) There are also some pocket-money-tracking and payment apps, such as RoosterMoney and goHenry, which are
   designed to be used by under-sevens, and which boast that they can help children develop good money habits.
   This  is dependent on the children receiving enough pocket money to need an app to track their spending,
   which research suggests is not always the case.

J) Surprisingly, given the research about habit-forming in young children, there are very few gaming apps that
   can help under-sevens—Pigby's Fair, developed by NatWest, being a notable exception. In this, children who
   solve basic puzzles will earn virtual money selling what they have made  at different  stalls in a  fair, then
   spend or save  it. But the need to shift virtual money around, and take into account interest payments and
   pocket money bonuses, makes it a complex financial education tool.

K) There are plenty of online games which focus on coin recognition and counting with money, such as the
    Igloo Shopping game or Top Marks' Coins Game. So what  if children find such games boring? An exciting
    (and free) real-world option for parents to use is a visit to Metro Bank. Although, like most banks,  it does
    not allow children to open an account until they turn 11,  it specifically tries to offer young children a chance
    to learn about money inside its branches by inviting kids to use the "magic money machines" to count their
    coins. Children who accurately guess how much was in their piggy bank(猪形储钱罐) get a prize, and free
    candies are handed out when the coins are exchanged for banknotes. The bank does not take a commission
   from the transaction.

Passage One
Questions 46 to 50 are based on the following passage.

    Three artists have brought a lawsuit against Stability AI, DeviantArt, and Midjourney, alleging that the text-
to-image AI tools have infringed the rights of thousands of artists.

    The lawsuit claims  that the Stable Diffusion tool used by  Stability AI, DeviantArt, and Midjourney was
trained on  billions of copyrighted images downloaded from the internet and used by the companies "without
compensation or consent from the artists."

    The artists are represented by The Joseph Saveri Law Firm and Matthew Butterick.

      "If Stable Diffusion and similar products are allowed to continue to operate as they do now, the foreseeable
result  is they will replace the very  artists whose stolen works power these AI products with whom they are
competing," the law firm wrote in a press release. "AI image products are not just an infringement of  artists'
rights; they will eliminate  'artist' as a viable career path. In addition to obtaining compensation for the wrongful
conduct, this lawsuit seeks to prevent that outcome and ensure these products follow the same rules as any other
new technology that involves the use of massive amounts of  intellectual property.  If streaming music can be
accomplished within the law, so can AI products."

     Since  text-to-image  generators have  increased  in  popularity  in  the  past  year, many  artists have been
vocalizing their opposition to AI art after seeing their own distorted signatures appear in AI art and finding out
that their work was used to train the tools without their permission.

    Not only are many  artists furious at the possible copyright violations of AI  art, but they have also been
frustrated by how AI tools are able to sidestep the labor and art processes they are required to go through. As a
result, many artists have been trying to ban AI art from art-sharing platforms.

    As AI innovation continues at a rapid speed,  it seems that artists and lawmakers are trying to put a brake
on further developments before it's too late.

   Many tech enthusiasts are still rallying around the promise of AI tools to create detailed images cheaply and
quickly—anonymous tech supporters have already published a response to Butterick and Joseph Saveri's lawsuit
on a website, using the "fair use" clause as the basis for why copyrighted images could be used by the tool.

     Fair use, a legal doctrine that allows for a limited usage of copyrighted materials without permission by the
original creators for purposes such as teaching and news sharing,  is what a  lot of generative model creators
claim that their training data is covered by. However, since fair use applies differently to each case,  it's hard to
make a blanket statement about all works in a dataset as being applicable.

Part I


Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence
"Faced with growing globalization,students realize that a deep understanding of traditional Chinese
culture helps  cultivate  cultural  confidence." You can make comments,  cite examples or use your
personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200
words.
You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.

【参考范文 · 162 词】 写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范

Faced with growing globalization,students realize that a deep understanding of traditional Chinese culture

helps cultivate cultural confidence. In an age when Western brands, movies and festivals flood daily life, many

young people begin to look back at their own roots. They find that cultural confidence cannot be borrowed

from outside; it must grow from real knowledge of what their ancestors created.

The reason is not hard to understand. Globalization exposes us to different values, yet it also makes us question

who we are. Only by learning the ideas behind Confucianism, the beauty of calligraphy, or the spirit of

traditional festivals can we answer that question with pride. Take the Spring Festival as an example: those who

understand its meaning of reunion and renewal celebrate it not out of habit, but out of identity.

Therefore, college students should actively read classics, visit museums and practice folk arts. The deeper we

understand traditional Chinese culture, the more confident we become in facing the world.

【参考译文】

来，而必须建立在对先辈所创造文化的真正了解之上。

其原因不难理解。全球化让我们接触到不同的价值观，但也让我们反思自己是谁。只有了解儒家思想背后
的理念、书法之美或传统节日的精神，我们才能自豪地回答这个问题。以春节为例：真正理解其团圆与更

  的文化自信。

   展开因果：文化自信不是空喊口号，而是建立在对儒家思想、书法、传统节日等具体内容理解
   之上的认同感。

      3. 青年应从具体文化实践入手增强自信

   给出行动：读经典、参观博物馆、参与民俗活动，把理解转化为日常实践，从而在全球化中保

R E V I E W · 自检避坑

本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标、容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容

  内容切题  紧扣首句三角关系
        本题最容易跑题：必须回应 Faced with growing globalization,students realize that a
              deep understanding of traditional Chinese culture helps cultivate cultural

        个关键词，不能只写“我爱中国文化”。


  结构连贯  三段逻辑闭环

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法


 脱离首句另起炉灶

  反面示例：As we all know, Chinese culture is very important and I love it very much. 问题：完全没
 有出现 globalization，也没照抄给定首句，等于另起话题。修正：Faced with growing
   globalization, students realize that a deep understanding of traditional Chinese culture helps
   cultivate cultural confidence. In an age when foreign cultures flood in, young people begin to
   rediscover their own roots.


 只喊口号不举例子

  反面示例：We should learn traditional culture because it is very good and important. 问题：没有
  具体例子，论证无力。修正：Take the Spring Festival as an example: those who understand its
   meaning of reunion celebrate it not out of habit, but out of identity.


 把文化自信写成狭隘民族主义

  反面示例：We must fight against Western culture to protect our own culture. 问题：把文化自信曲
  解为排外对立。修正：Cultural confidence means understanding our own heritage while staying
  open to the world.


 字数注水或不足

  反面示例：Traditional Chinese culture is very important. It is very important for us. We must learn
     it because it is important. 问题：重复 important，无实质内容。修正：Only by learning the ideas
   behind Confucianism and the beauty of calligraphy can we build real cultural confidence.


 三段内容写成一段

 反面示例：把首句、原因、例子、呼吁全部挤在一个自然段里。问题：结构混乱，阅卷人找不到层

真题卷第3套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part III Section A


Directions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for
each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through
carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the
corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not
use any of the words in the bank more than once.

    Imagine you and a stranger are sitting on a couch. How close would you sit to them?  It turns out
that how much of a       26      zone you prefer may reveal a lot about your personality.
设想一下，你和一个陌生人正坐在沙发上。你会离对方多近？事实证明，你偏好的缓冲距离或许能揭示许
多有关你个性的信息。

     In one study, researchers sought to       27      how our personality may be linked to our preferred
amount of personal space. The researchers found  that people who scored higher in the       28       of
agreeableness tended to sit closer to others, as did people who were more open and outgoing.
在一项研究中，研究人员试图确定我们的个性可能与我们偏好的个人空间大小之间存在怎样的联系。研
究人员发现，在随和性这一特质上得分较高的人往往会坐得离他人更近，性格更加开放和外向的人也是
如此。

    Other individual differences, such as gender and age, can also affect how much personal space we
     29        . Women tend  to prefer more physical distance from strangers or acquaintances and older
adults also generally tend to prefer to keep more distance between themselves and others.
性别和年龄等其他个体差异也会影响我们渴望保持多大的个人空间。女性往往更喜欢与陌生人或熟人保持
更大的身体距离，而老年人通常也更倾向于在自己与他人之间保持更远的距离。

    Beyond reflecting our personality and       30        , the amount of personal space we prefer  is also
linked to our cultural backgrounds. In a study involving participants from 42 countries, researchers found
that around the world people's desired amount of personal space varied       31        . For example, in

Romania, the average amount of personal space people said they would prefer from a stranger was more
than 4 feet, whereas in Argentina it was roughly half that.
除了反映我们的个性和人口特征之外，我们偏好的个人空间大小还与我们的文化背景有关。在一项涉及42
个国家参与者的研究中，研究人员发现，世界各地人们期望的个人空间大小存在很大差异。例如，在罗马
尼亚，人们表示希望与陌生人保持的平均个人空间超过4英尺，而在阿根廷，这一距离大约只有一半。

    What might       32       this variation? The researchers looked at a number of       33       factors, but
the  only  one  that  was  significantly        34       with  preferred  interpersonal  distance  was  average
temperature. The warmer the place,  it seems, the "warmer" the people and the less space they needed
between them and others.
这种差异可能是由什么造成的？研究人员考察了许多潜在因素，但唯一与人际距离偏好显著相关的因素是
平均气温。一个地方越温暖，那里的人似乎就越“热情”，他们与他人之间所需要的空间也越小。

     Personal space may also  reflect interpersonal  attraction. Researchers have found  that our chosen
physical       35       also appears to reflect how much we like others. The more people would like to be
friends with the other person, the closer they sat to them.
个人空间也可能反映人际吸引力。研究人员发现，我们选择的身体距离似乎也反映了我们有多喜欢他人。
人们越希望与对方成为朋友，就会坐得离对方越近。

text:
26. how much of a __(26)__ zone you prefer

【答案】B) buffer 名词

【词性槽】a ___ zone：冠词 a 后、名词 zone 前，要一个单数名词作定语

【依据】buffer zone 是固定搭配，指人和人之间的"缓冲地带"

        Imagine you and a stranger are sitting on a couch. How close would you sit to
       them? 讲的是与陌生人保持的距离，buffer 与 zone 构成固定搭配 buffer zone（缓冲地
     带），代进去即"你偏好多大的缓冲距离"，与全文 personal space 主题严丝合缝。

【竞争词】I) potential 义近形可但搭配不指向距离

            potential 作名词是"潜力"，potential zone 不成常见搭配，且与上下文"坐得多近"的距离话题
      无关。

          J) proximity 语义方向相反

           proximity 是"接近、邻近"，proximity zone 不成搭配；且全文讲的是"留多远"的间隔而非"靠
         近区"，proximity 要留到 35 空用。

          L) statistics 复数形式被 a 卡死，语义也不通

              statistics 是复数，不能与 a 连用；"统计区域"也与个人空间话题无关。

          N) trait trait zone 不成搭配

               trait 是"性格特质"，确与本文话题沾边，但 trait 与 zone 不构成搭配；trait 的用武之地是 28
      空 the trait of agreeableness。

text:
27. researchers sought to __(27)__ how our personality may be linked to our preferred amount of
personal space

【答案】A) ascertain 动词

【词性槽】sought to ___：不定式 to 后接动词原形作谓语目的

【依据】研究者"着手查明"性格与空间偏好的关联

         ascertain 意为"查明、弄清"，后接 how 从句正合"研究者试图弄清性格如何与个人空间偏
     好相关联"；下一句 The researchers found that people who scored higher 的 found
    （发现）正是 ascertain 的结果，前后动作链吻合。

【竞争词】D) crave crave how 从句搭配不成立

           crave 是"渴望"，宾语多为具体事物（crave attention/food），不接 how 从句；"渴望性格如
       何关联"语义不通。crave 是 29 空的答案。

          F) entail entail 主语是事情、不接 how 从句

             entail 意为"牵涉、需要"，典型用法是"某事 entails 某后果"，主语不能是 researchers 去"牵涉
      how……"，语义与搭配双重不合。

          O) underlie 研究者不能"构成……的基础"

            underlie 意为"是……背后的原因"，其主语应是某个因素（如温度），而本句主语是
          researchers——人不会"underlie 一个疑问"。underlie 是 32 空（What might underlie this
         variation）的答案。

     28. people who scored higher in the __(28)__ of agreeableness

【答案】N) trait 名词

【词性槽】the ___ of agreeableness：冠词 the 后、介词 of 前，要单数名词

【依据】agreeableness 是一种性格"特质"，the trait of 搭配地道

           trait 意为"（性格）特质"，agreeableness（亲和性）正是心理学"大五人格"里的一种
         trait；the trait of agreeableness = "亲和性这一特质"。后半句 as did people who were
       more open and outgoing 列举的 open、outgoing 也都是 trait，同范畴复现是强信号。

【竞争词】I) potential "在亲和性的潜力上得分高"语义拧巴

            potential 作名词是"潜力"，score higher in the potential of agreeableness 说不通——测评
      打分量的是特质高低，不是潜力。

          J) proximity 范畴错配：proximity 是距离不是特质

           proximity 意为"接近"，the proximity of agreeableness 不成语义组合；本句 scored higher
      in…要的是可被打分的性格维度。

          L) statistics 复数加范畴双错

              statistics 复数形式与 the…of 单数框架不合；"亲和性的统计数据"也无法让人"得分更高"。

text:
29. Other individual differences, such as gender and age, can also affect how much personal space
we __(29)__

【答案】D) crave 动词

【词性槽】how much personal space we ___：宾语从句中 we 后缺谓语动词

【依据】crave = 内心"需要/想要"多少空间，与 prefer 同义线

        crave 意为"渴望、需要"，how much personal space we crave = "我们需要/想要多少个
     人空间"。下文 Women tend to prefer more physical distance from strangers 反复用
      prefer（偏好）谈同一概念，crave 正是 prefer 的同义复现，扣住全文"偏好"主线。

【竞争词】F) entail entail 主语是事不是人，义也不通

             entail 意为"牵涉、使必要"，用法是"做某事 entails 某种代价"；主语 we（人）+ 宾语
           personal space 构成"我们牵涉空间"，搭配与语义双崩。它是本空最像答案的干扰词。

【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 F) —— entail 词性对、够正式，看着像"高级答案"。how much
        personal space we __(29)__ 中 entail 是动词原形、词性全对，又因生僻显得"像六级答
     案"。防坑一句话：把主谓宾连读——"we entail space（我们牵涉空间）"不通，entail 的
     主语须是事情；人才会"想要空间"，故选 crave。

     30. Beyond reflecting our personality and __(30)__, the amount of personal space we prefer is also
linked to our cultural backgrounds

【答案】E) demographics 名词

【词性槽】personality and ___：并列连词 and 后要与 personality 同类的名词

【依据】demographics 正是上一段 gender and age 的总称

        demographics 意为"人口统计特征"。第 3 段 Other individual differences, such as
        gender and age, can also affect 讲的性别、年龄正是 demographics 的内容；本
       句"Beyond reflecting our personality and demographics"用 Beyond 把前两段（性格 +
    人口特征）一并收进，再引出文化背景——行文是"性格→人口属性→文化"的递进，
        demographics 正好是中间那一环。

【竞争词】I) potential potential 与 personality 不在一个范畴

            potential 作名词"潜力"与"性格"并列生硬；且前文从没谈过"个人空间反映潜力"，无文本支撑
      （无中生有）。

          L) statistics 个人空间不"反映我们的统计数字"

              statistics 是研究者的数据，不是"我们的"属性；our personality and statistics 说不通，命题人
      用它钓"研究语境里见过 statistics"的印象分。

【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 L) —— statistics 蹭研究语境的热度，顺手就填。Beyond
          reflecting our personality and __(30)__ 处于满篇 study/researchers 的文本里，
          statistics 凭"语境眼熟"极具诱惑。防坑一句话：and 并列要语义平级——personality 是个
    人属性，能与之平起平坐且对应上段 gender and age 的只有 demographics，不是研究数
    据 statistics。





               懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/cet6/sections/2026-06-3/part3-section-a/?f=p · 在线使用效果更好

text:
31. people's desired amount of personal space varied __(31)__

【答案】M) substantially 副词

【词性槽】varied ___：不及物动词 varied 后缺修饰成分，要副词

【依据】substantially 修饰 varied 表"差异巨大"，与跨国数据呼应

         substantially 意为"大幅度地"，varied substantially = "差异悬殊"。紧接的对比例证 in
        Romania, the average amount of personal space people said they would prefer from
        a stranger was more than 4 feet, whereas in Argentina it was roughly half that（4 英
    尺 vs 约 2 英尺）正是"差很多"的实据。

【竞争词】G) legitimately "合法地/正当地差异"语义不通

            legitimately 意为"合法地、合情合理地"，多修饰 claim/derive 等表权利或推理的词；个人空间
      偏好的差异不存在"合法与否"的问题，修饰 varied 不成立。

     32. What might __(32)__ this variation?

【答案】O) underlie 动词

【词性槽】What might ___ this variation：情态动词 might 后接动词原形作谓语

【依据】underlie this variation = 是什么"造成/构成"了这种差异

         underlie 意为"构成……的基础、是……背后的原因"。本段正是追问成因：下一句 The
         researchers looked at a number of __(33)__ factors 到"唯一相关的是气温"，整段在找差
     异背后的原因——What might underlie this variation? 正是这一问句的总起。

【竞争词】D) crave crave 的主语须是有欲求的人

           crave 是"渴望"，主语必须是人或动物；本句主语 What 指某个抽象原因，"什么渴望这种差
        异"不通。crave 真正的家在 29 空（we crave personal space）。

          F) entail entail 问的是"带来什么后果"，方向反了

             entail 意为"牵涉、必然带来"，逻辑方向是"因 → 果"（A entails B = A 必然牵连 B）；而本句
      问的是"果 ← 因"（什么导致了差异），且下文答的是气温这一成因而非后果，方向对不上。这
      是最像答案的干扰。

text:
33. The researchers looked at a number of __(33)__ factors

【答案】I) potential 形容词

【词性槽】a number of ___ factors：量词短语后、名词 factors 前，要形容词作定语

【依据】potential factors = 排查"候选的、可能的因素"，正对研究筛选语境

         potential 意为"潜在的、可能的"。本句讲研究者排查若干可能因素，下句 but the only
       one that was significantly __(34)__ with preferred interpersonal distance was average
        temperature 的"只剩一个"正是"从潜在因素中筛选"的结果——potential 与 looked at…
        only one 的筛选叙事严丝合缝。

【竞争词】H) mandated "被强制的因素"与研究语境无关

         mandated 意为"被法规强制的"，全文没有任何法规/政策语境，mandated factors 属无中生
      有；研究者排查的是"可能的"因素，不是"被规定的"因素。

          K) rigid rigid 修饰人/规则，不修饰因素

             rigid 意为"僵硬的、死板的"，常修饰 rules/attitude；rigid factors 搭配生硬，且与下文"只有
      气温相关"的筛选逻辑无关。

     34. but  the  only one  that was  significantly __(34)__  with  preferred  interpersonal  distance was
average temperature

【答案】C) correlated 形容词

【词性槽】was significantly ___ with：系动词 was 后、副词后、介词 with 前，要形容词（或分词
     形容词）

【依据】be correlated with = 与……相关，科学研究高频搭配

         correlated 与 was…with 构成 be correlated with（与……相关），代进去即"唯一与偏好
    的人际距离显著相关的因素"。下句 The warmer the place, it seems, the "warmer" the
        people and the less space they needed 正说明气温与距离此消彼长的相关关系，语义
    闭环。

【竞争词】H) mandated be mandated with 搭配不成立

         mandated 是"被强制规定"，mandate 的搭配是 mandate that…/be mandated to do，不与
           with 搭配；"气温被强制与距离有关"也荒谬。

          I) potential potential 不接 with，且与 only one 冲突

            potential 意为"潜在的"，potential 常直接修饰名词（potential factors），"was significantly
            potential with"既不成搭配，也和本句"筛了一圈只剩这一个"的确指语境矛盾。它是 33 空的
      答案。

          K) rigid rigid with 不表"相关"，语义跑偏

             rigid 是"僵硬的、严格的"，be rigid with 不表关联义；本句要的是统计学上的"相关"概念，不
       是"严格"。

text:
35. our chosen physical __(35)__ also appears to reflect how much we like others

【答案】J) proximity 名词

【词性槽】physical ___：形容词 physical 后作其中心语，要名词

【依据】physical proximity = 身体上的靠近，正对"坐多近"

         proximity 意为"接近、邻近"，physical proximity 是地道搭配（身体距离上的靠近）。下
    一句 The more people would like to be friends with the other person, the closer they
         sat to them 的 closer they sat 正是 proximity 的行为化表达，首尾呼应。

【竞争词】E) demographics "被选择的身体人口特征"逻辑不通

          demographics 指性别年龄等群体属性，既不能 physical（身体的人口特征？）也不能 chosen
      （人口特征不是"选"出来的）；它是 30 空的答案。

          I) potential physical potential 偏离"坐近"话题

            potential 作名词是"潜力"，"身体潜力反映多喜欢对方"与本段"坐得越近=越喜欢"的语义线
      不符。

          L) statistics physical statistics 搭配生硬且非话题

              statistics 是"统计数据"，physical statistics 非常规搭配；本句主语须是人们能"选择"的距离行
      为，统计数字无从 chosen。



W O R D  B A N K · 词库分类表

15 个候选词 · 词性与词义

选词填空文后的共享词库共 15 个词（A–O），为 10 个空各选一个、每词最多用一次。
下面给出每个词的词性与中文词义；标注「用于第 N 空」的 10 个为答案，其余 5 个为干
扰词。

D I S T R A C T O R S · 干扰词复盘

这 5 个词始终没被任何空选用

词库 15 词里有 5 个是命题人埋的干扰词——它们词性看着也对、词义也沾点边，却不该
填进任何一个空。下面逐个剖析它们最像哪个空的答案、为什么是陷阱。




   F) entail 最像 32 空"什么造成差异"的答案

    entail 同为正式因果类动词，极易与 underlie 混淆。识破靠因果方向：What might __(32)__ this
    variation? 问的是差异"背后的原因"（果←因，选 underlie），而 entail 是"因带出果"（A entails
  B）；再记 entail 主语须是"事情"，29 空主语 we（人）也容不下它。



   G) legitimately 31 空副词二选一的另一半

    legitimately 是词库仅有的两个副词之一，天然有 50% 的诱惑率。识破靠"动词有没有这个维度"：
   personal space varied __(31)__ 的 varied 只有程度维度（差得多/少），没有合法性维度，故
    legitimately 无从修饰。



   H) mandated 形近 correlated，易被当成 34 空的"正式词汇"

   mandated 与 correlated 同为 -ed 分词形态，看着都像"学术词"。识破靠空后介词：34 空是 was…
  with，英语只有 be correlated with；be mandated 后接 to do 或 by，永远不接 with。



   K) rigid 33 空"rigid factors"貌似说得过去

    rigid 是形容词栏常客，33 空 a number of __(33)__ factors 词性也对。识破靠叙事：本句讲"排查若
  干候选因素、最后只剩气温"，是筛选语境，形容词只能是表"可能的"的 potential；rigid（死板
  的）与筛选逻辑无关。



   L) statistics "研究文里必有 statistics"的印象陷阱，最像 30 空

    statistics 沾研究语境的光，易被塞进 30 空"personality and ___"。识破靠并列对齐：and 前
    personality 是"我们的个人属性"，空处也须是个人属性（demographics = 性别年龄）；statistics
  是研究者的数据，且复数形式进不了多个单数框架。

    It turns out that how much of a buffer zone you prefer may reveal a lot about your
   personality.

  第1段，第3句

  以 "It turns out that..." 开头并叠加从句嵌套的句式在四六级和考研阅读真题中极其常见，掌握其拆
  解路径具有很强的可迁移性。



  The researchers found that people who scored higher in the trait of agreeableness
   tended to sit closer to others, as did people who were more open and outgoing.

  第2段，第2句

  该句呈现了学术阅读与真题中极为高频的“研究发现 + 定语从句限定受试 + 比较倒装”典型句式，
  掌握后复用迁移价值极高。



   In a study involving participants from 42 countries, researchers found that around
   the world people's desired amount of personal space varied substantially.

  第4段，第2句

  “状语 + 主语 + 谓语动词 + that 引导的宾语从句”是学术论文摘要和阅读理解真题中极高频出现的
  典型句式。



   For example, in Romania, the average amount of personal space people said they
  would prefer from a stranger was more than 4 feet, whereas in Argentina it was
   roughly half that.

  第4段，第3句

  本句涵盖了双重省略从句（省略关系代词与引导词）、对比状语从句以及跨分句代词指代，是训练
  句子成分划分与上下文指代认定的优质材料。

真题卷第3套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part III Section B


Directions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to  it. Each
statement contains information given in one of the paragraphs. Identify the paragraph from which the
information is derived. You may choose a paragraph more than once. Each paragraph is marked with a
letter. Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.

                                It's never too early to teach children about money

A) The cost of a mortgage or rents, meeting monthly utility bills, paying for a new car—all headaches
   most people get to worry about from their 20s. But while some may struggle to pay their bills after
    a few too many nights out at the  start of the month, others will have a tightly followed plan for
    their repayments. So what is the difference between the shrewd saver and the more reckless spender?
  抵押贷款或房租的费用、每月缴纳水电等生活账单、支付一辆新车的费用——这些都是大多数人从二
  十多岁起就要操心的头疼事。不过，有些人可能会因为月初外出玩乐的夜晚太多而难以支付账单，另
  一些人却会严格遵循还款计划。那么，精明的储蓄者与更为鲁莽的花钱者之间究竟有什么区别呢？

B) Experts believe  it is all about the age you learn how to spend responsibly. Adult money habits are
    typically set by the age of seven, according to a large-scale study by the government's Money Advice
    Service and behaviour experts at Cambridge University. By then, most children have grasped how to
    recognise the value of money and are capable of complex functions such as planning ahead, delaying
    a decision until later and understanding that some choices are irreversible.
  专家认为，这一切都取决于你在什么年龄学会负责任地消费。政府的金钱咨询服务机构与剑桥大学的
  行为专家开展的一项大规模研究显示，成年人的金钱习惯通常在七岁时就已经形成。到那时，大多数
  孩子已经掌握了如何识别金钱价值，并且能够进行一些复杂的思考，例如提前规划、将决定推迟到以
  后再做，以及理解有些选择是不可逆的。

C) Tomorrow marks the start of Global Money Week, a worldwide initiative to help children make smart
    financial decisions and learn that "money matters matter". But for many young people in the UK,  it's
    a matter of too  little, too  late. "The habits of mind which influence the ways children approach

text:
complex problems and decisions, including financial ones, are largely determined in the  first few
    years of life," says Dr David Whitebread, the co-author of the study. And this core behaviour is very
    likely to influence their financial decisions when they are adults, he says.
  明天将迎来全球金钱周的开始。这是一项旨在帮助儿童作出明智的财务决定，并让他们懂得“金钱问题
  很重要”的全球性倡议。但对英国的许多年轻人来说，这已经是一个太少、太晚的问题。“影响儿童处
  理复杂问题和作出决定，包括财务决定的思维习惯，很大程度上是在生命最初几年形成的，”该研究的
  共同作者戴维·怀特布雷德博士说。他表示，这种核心行为很可能会影响他们成年后的财务决定。

D) The study also urges parents not to underestimate  their own good and bad money  habits. "Since
   young children have few monetary resources they control independently,  it  is the basic approaches
   and skills which are modelled, discussed and demonstrated by parents that are likely to be influential
    levers, breeding efficient habits and practices," it says.
  这项研究还敦促父母不要低估自己良好或不良金钱习惯的影响。“由于幼儿能够独立支配的金钱资源很
  少，因此，父母所示范、讨论和展示的基本方法与技能，很可能是促成有效习惯和做法的重要影响因
  素，”研究报告称。

E) Parents who choose to help  their children learn how to plan ahead,  reflect on the past and  self-
    regulate can make a huge difference in promoting good financial behaviour in the future, explains
   Whitebread. According  to  a  survey by M&G  Investments,  the  vast  majority (83%)  of  parents
    recognise the value of teaching their children about money. However, this concern does not always
    carry through to practice—one in six do not feel confident enough to do  it. More than one in every
    four parents think children should take responsibility for understanding money themselves.
  怀特布雷德解释说，选择帮助孩子学会提前规划、反思过去并进行自我调节的父母，可以在促进孩子
  未来良好财务行为方面发挥巨大作用。M&G投资公司的一项调查显示，绝大多数父母（83%）都认识
  到教孩子了解金钱的价值。然而，这种关注并不总能落实到实践中——六分之一的父母觉得自己没有
  足够的信心去做这件事。超过四分之一的父母认为，孩子应该自己负责了解金钱。

F) "There's joy in the fact that young children are spontaneous and live life in the moment, unrestrained
   by  adult problems. But teaching children about money when they are young  is a good way  for
    parents to help them learn to delay satisfaction, so that the child thinks:  'I'd like to do this but I'm
   not going  to'. Hard evidence suggests,  if you want your child to do well in life, the earlier you can
    start  trying  to teach them  inhibition and  self-discipline,  the  better," says Whitebread, pointing  to
   research that has shown people in prison frequently have poor impulse control, a personality trait that
   can affect relationships and long-term health.
  “幼儿 spontanes地生活在当下，不受成年人的烦恼束缚，这其中自有乐趣。但在孩子年幼时教他们认
  识金钱，是父母帮助他们学会延迟满足的一种好方法，这样孩子就会想：‘我想做这件事，但我不会去
  做。’确凿的证据表明，如果你希望孩子一生过得好，那么越早开始尝试教他们克制和自律，效果就越
  好，”怀特布雷德说。他指出，有研究显示，监狱中的人往往缺乏控制冲动的能力，而这种人格特征可
  能影响人际关系和长期健康。

G) But how should a parent try to teach their child to spend responsibly? One simple way  is to give
   them pocket money and then help them to analyse and learn from any foolish spending decisions.
  但是，父母应该怎样教孩子负责任地消费呢？一个简单的方法是给孩子零花钱，然后帮助他们分析并
  从任何不理智的消费决定中吸取教训。

text:
H) Another  is through board games which can help teach financial responsibility. Pop to the Shops, a
    shopping board game for five-to-nine-year-olds, has been one of Orchard Toys' top 10 bestselling
    board games every year for the past 15 years. To win, players must use fake coins to purchase
    everyday grocery items from various shops around the board, and give the other players who visit
    their shop the correct change. If they don't have enough money, they must purchase a cheaper item.
     "It  acts as a conversation  starter about money—parents can  fill  in the gaps," says Orchard Toys
    product manager Rachael Sutcliffe.
  另一种方法是通过棋盘游戏来帮助孩子学习财务责任感。面向五至九岁儿童的购物棋盘游戏《去商店
  吧》在过去15年中每年都跻身Orchard Toys最畅销的十大棋盘游戏之列。为了获胜，玩家必须使用假
  硬币，在棋盘周围的不同商店购买日常食品，并且要给到访自己商店的其他玩家找对零钱。如果钱不
  够，他们就必须购买更便宜的商品。Orchard Toys的产品经理蕾切尔·萨克利夫说：“它可以成为一个
  谈论金钱的开端，父母可以补充其中的不足。”

I) There are also some pocket-money-tracking and payment apps, such as RoosterMoney and goHenry,
   which are designed to be used by under-sevens, and which boast that they can help children develop
  good money habits. This is dependent on the children receiving enough pocket money to need an app
   to track their spending, which research suggests is not always the case.
 还有一些追踪零花钱和支付的应用程序，例如RoosterMoney和goHenry，它们面向七岁以下儿童设
 计，并声称能够帮助孩子养成良好的金钱习惯。不过，这取决于孩子是否能获得足够多的零花钱，以至
 于需要使用应用程序来追踪支出，而研究表明，情况并不总是如此。

J) Surprisingly, given the research about habit-forming in young children, there are very few gaming
   apps that can help under-sevens—Pigby's Fair, developed by NatWest, being a notable exception. In
    this,  children who  solve  basic  puzzles  will  earn  virtual money  selling what  they have made  at
   different stalls in a fair, then spend or save  it. But the need to shift virtual money around, and take
   into account  interest payments and pocket money bonuses, makes  it a complex financial education
    tool.

真题卷第3套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part III Section C


Directions: There  are 2 passages  in  this  section. Each passage  is  followed by some  questions or
unfinished statements. For each of them there are four choices marked A)  , B)  , C) and D)  . You should
decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding  letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single  line
through the centre.

Passage One
Questions 46 to 50 are based on the following passage.

    P1 Three  artists have brought a lawsuit against Stability AI, DeviantArt, and Midjourney, alleging
that the text-to-image AI tools have infringed the rights of thousands of artists.
三位艺术家已对 Stability AI、DeviantArt 和 Midjourney 提起诉讼，指控这些文本生成图像的人工智能
工具侵犯了数千名艺术家的权利。

    P2 The  lawsuit  claims  that  the  Stable  Diffusion  tool  used  by  Stability  AI,  DeviantArt,  and
Midjourney was trained on billions of copyrighted images downloaded from the internet and used by the
companies "without compensation or consent from the artists."
诉讼称，Stability AI、DeviantArt 和 Midjourney 使用的 Stable Diffusion 工具，是利用从互联网下载
的数十亿张受版权保护的图像进行训练的，而这些公司使用这些图像时“没有向艺术家提供补偿，也未获
得他们的同意”。

    P3 The artists are represented by The Joseph Saveri Law Firm and Matthew Butterick.
这些艺术家由 The Joseph Saveri Law Firm 和 Matthew Butterick 代理。

    P4  "If Stable Diffusion and similar products are allowed to continue to operate as they do now, the
foreseeable result is they will replace the very artists whose stolen works power these AI products with
whom they are competing," the law firm wrote in a press release. "AI image products are not just an
infringement of artists' rights; they will eliminate  'artist' as a viable career path. In addition to obtaining
compensation  for the wrongful conduct,  this lawsuit seeks  to prevent  that outcome and ensure these

products follow the same rules as any other new technology that involves the use of massive amounts of
intellectual property. If streaming music can be accomplished within the law, so can AI products."
该律师事务所在一份新闻稿中写道：“如果允许 Stable Diffusion 及类似产品继续以目前的方式运营，那
么可以预见的结果是，它们将取代那些为这些人工智能产品提供动力、而这些产品正与之竞争的艺术家，
而被取代的正是其作品遭到窃取的艺术家。人工智能图像产品不仅侵犯了艺术家的权利，还将使‘艺术家’
不再是一条可行的职业道路。除了为不当行为寻求赔偿外，本诉讼还旨在阻止这一结果，并确保这些产品
遵守与任何其他涉及使用大量知识产权的新技术相同的规则。如果音乐流媒体能够在法律框架内实现，人
工智能产品也同样可以做到。”

    P5 Since text-to-image generators have increased in popularity in the past year, many  artists have
been vocalizing their opposition to AI art after seeing their own distorted signatures appear in AI art and
finding out that their work was used to train the tools without their permission.
在过去一年中，随着文本生成图像工具越来越受欢迎，许多艺术家在看到自己扭曲的签名出现在人工智能
生成的艺术作品中，并发现自己的作品未经许可就被用于训练这些工具后，纷纷公开表达对人工智能艺术
的反对。

    P6 Not only are many artists furious at the possible copyright violations of AI  art, but they have
also been frustrated by how AI tools are able to sidestep the labor and art processes they are required to
go through. As a result, many artists have been trying to ban AI art from art-sharing platforms.
许多艺术家不仅对人工智能艺术可能侵犯版权感到愤怒，也因人工智能工具能够绕过他们必须经历的劳动
和艺术创作过程而感到沮丧。因此，许多艺术家一直在试图禁止人工智能艺术进入艺术分享平台。

    P7 As AI innovation continues at a rapid speed,  it seems that artists and lawmakers are trying to
put a brake on further developments before it's too late.
随着人工智能创新以极快的速度持续发展，艺术家和立法者似乎正试图在为时已晚之前遏制进一步的
发展。

    P8 Many tech enthusiasts are still rallying around the promise of AI tools to create detailed images
cheaply and quickly—anonymous tech supporters have already published a response  to Butterick and
Joseph Saveri's lawsuit on a website, using the "fair use" clause as the basis for why copyrighted images
could be used by the tool.
许多科技爱好者仍在支持人工智能工具能够低成本、快速创作精细图像这一前景；匿名的科技支持者已经
在一个网站上发布了对 Butterick 和 Joseph Saveri 诉讼的回应，以“合理使用”条款为依据，解释为什么
这些受版权保护的图像可以被该工具使用。

    P9  Fair  use, a  legal  doctrine  that allows  for a  limited usage  of copyrighted  materials without
permission by the original creators for purposes such as teaching and news sharing,  is what a  lot of
generative model creators claim that their training data  is covered by. However, since  fair use applies
differently to each case,  it's hard to make a blanket statement about  all works in a dataset as being
applicable.
合理使用是一项法律原则，允许出于教学和新闻传播等目的，在未经原作者许可的情况下有限使用受版权
保护的材料。许多生成模型的创作者声称，他们的训练数据受到这一原则的保护。然而，由于合理使用在
不同案件中的适用方式各不相同，因此很难笼统地断言数据集中的所有作品都适用这一原则。

46. Why have three artists brought a lawsuit against Stability AI, DeviantArt, and Midjourney?

   A) They claim that the use of the Stable Diffusion tool is a violation of law.

   B) They claim these companies infringed their intellectual property rights.

   C) They want to stop the use of all AI tools in the creation of art works.

   D) They want to prevent artists from being compelled to rely on AI tools.

A) 他们声称使用 Stable Diffusion 工具违反法律。  B) 他们声称这些公司侵犯了自己的知识产权。

C) 他们想阻止在艺术作品创作中使用一切人工智能工具。

D) 他们想防止艺术家被迫依赖人工智能工具。
【答案】B （细节题）

    原因，无否定、比较等陷阱。

          alleging that the text-to-image AI tools have infringed the rights of thousands of artists.

Part III Section C (2)


Directions: There  are 2 passages  in  this  section. Each passage  is  followed by some  questions or
unfinished statements. For each of them there are four choices marked A)  , B)  , C) and D)  . You should
decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding  letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single  line
through the centre.

Passage Two
Questions 51 to 55 are based on the following passage.

    P1 On a warm October morning, Daniel Agok woke up to another disappointing day at his school
in Wanyjok, South Sudan. The  classes he had planned  teaching computer  skills  to  aspiring young
professionals were canceled, due to an unreliable diesel generator and the absence of a municipal power
grid in his area. Now, he would be losing frustrated customers as well as income. Agok is just one of
the hundreds of millions of people in sub-Saharan Africa, many of whom are business owners, who still
do not have dependable electricity. This inequitable access to energy continues to put their livelihood and
future at risk.
十月一个温暖的早晨，丹尼尔·阿戈克醒来时，迎接他的又是南苏丹瓦尼约克学校里令人失望的一天。由于
柴油发电机运行不稳定，而且他所在地区没有市政电网，他原本计划为有志成为年轻专业人士的人教授计
算机技能的课程被取消了。现在，他不仅会失去因失望而离去的客户，还会损失收入。阿戈克只是撒哈拉
以南非洲数亿人的代表之一，其中许多人是企业主，至今仍没有可靠的电力供应。这种不公平的能源获取
状况持续使他们的生计和未来面临风险。

    P2 The current system keeps a lid on the economic talents of people like Agok and his students.
We must instead unleash  their  abilities and  let Africa reach  its  true economic  potential. That means
wiring Africa with clean, dependable energy.
现行体系限制了阿戈克及其学生这类人的经济才能。相反，我们必须释放他们的能力，让非洲实现真正的
经济潜力。这意味着要用清洁、可靠的能源为非洲接入电网。

text:
P3  Historically, national governments on the continent have led electrification efforts, but fewer than
half of the people surveyed say that the national grid is providing a reliable supply of electricity.
从历史上看，非洲大陆各国政府一直主导着电气化工作，但接受调查的人中，不到一半表示国家电网能够
提供可靠的电力供应。

    P4 This has led to expensive and harmful temporary "solutions". In Nigeria alone experts estimate
people spend $13 billion every year on fuel for toxic, polluting generators. That number will only grow
as the continent's population hits 2.5 billion people by 2050. Deploying modern grid infrastructure with
speed and  at  scale  is  essential  to  replacing  these temporary  solutions  with  reliable and  affordable
alternatives.
这导致了昂贵且有害的临时“解决方案”。专家估计，仅在尼日利亚，人们每年就要花费130亿美元购买有
毒且污染环境的发电机燃料。随着非洲大陆人口到2050年达到25亿，这一数字只会继续增长。快速、大
规模部署现代电网基础设施，对于用可靠且价格可负担的替代方案取代这些临时解决方案至关重要。

    P5 The rapidly growing private power sector in Africa holds the key to achieving the speed and
scale necessary to close the continent's energy access gap. Private companies today are building world-
class infrastructure and driving forward economic growth with sustainable business models. In fact, many
governments agree and have begun to embrace the private sector as partners in providing reliable power
at scale. In South Africa, President Cyril Ramaphosa has streamlined licensing requirements and enlisted
the private sector to play a key role.
非洲迅速发展的私人电力行业，是以实现弥合非洲大陆能源获取缺口所需的速度和规模的关键。如今，私
营企业正在建设世界一流的基础设施，并通过可持续的商业模式推动经济增长。事实上，许多政府对此表
示认同，并已开始接受私营部门作为合作伙伴，以大规模提供可靠电力。在南非，西里尔·拉马福萨总统简
化了许可要求，并邀请私营部门发挥关键作用。

    P6 South Africa  is just one example. Across the continent, the private sector has delivered power
faster and more reliably, and governments are increasingly turning to private partners.
南非只是其中一个例子。在整个非洲大陆，私营部门以更快的速度提供了更加可靠的电力，各国政府也越
来越多地寻求与私营合作伙伴合作。

    P7 With the right funding and structure in place, the private sector will come together to provide
this essential service. After all, electrifying sub-Saharan Africa is a $350 billion opportunity.
只要建立适当的资金和组织架构，私营部门就会联合起来提供这项基本服务。毕竟，为撒哈拉以南非洲实
现电气化蕴含着3500亿美元的机遇。

    P8 Today, Daniel Agok is steadily growing his business in South Sudan. His town of Wanyjok was
electrified by a private company, providing clean, reliable, and affordable power to his business and his
neighbors. Agok now operates his growing computer skills training business smoothly. His classes are no
longer affected by the smell and the constant noise of the diesel generator, and he saves money with
more affordable power. His students are developing hardware and software skills.
如今，丹尼尔·阿戈克正在稳步发展他在南苏丹的企业。瓦尼约克镇由一家私营公司实现了电气化，为他的
企业和邻居们提供了清洁、可靠且价格可负担的电力。阿戈克现在可以顺利运营不断发展的计算机技能培
训业务。他的课程不再受到柴油发电机气味和持续噪声的影响，而且借助价格更低的电力，他节省了开
支。他的学生正在培养硬件和软件技能。

text:
题目与逐题解析

51. What do we learn about the current electric supply system in Africa?

   A) It curbs the economic development of the continent.

   B) It mainly depends on the polluting diesel generators.

   C) It is the primary cause of inequitable distribution of wealth.

   D) It deprives many Africans of the opportunity to use computers.

我们从中了解到非洲目前的电力供应系统有什么情况?
A) 它抑制了该大陆的经济发展。  B) 它主要依赖污染性的柴油发电机。

C) 它是财富分配不公平的主要原因。  D) 它剥夺了许多非洲人使用计算机的机会。
【答案】A （细节题）

【判型】What do we learn about the current electric supply system in Africa?询问对某事物的
      客观事实，无infer/imply/suggest等推断信号。

【拆句】What do we learn about the current electric supply system in Africa?为主谓宾结构，
     主干是What do we learn，about...引出询问对象；全句无否定、无从句，理解难度低。

【定位】The current system keeps a lid on the economic talents of people like Agok and his students.

     当前的电力系统抑制了像Agok和他的学生这样的人的经济才能。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确
             keeps a lid on the economic talents ↔It curbs the economic development of the continent
          The current system keeps a lid on the economic talents of people like Agok and
             his students.直接对应It curbs the economic development of the continent，只是
      将具体人才能扩展为大陆层面的经济发展。

        B) 偷换概念
       原文说人们花钱买柴油发电机是临时方案，而非current electric supply system本身；
                  It mainly depends on the polluting diesel generators把主体换成了电力系统。

        C) 无中生有/强加因果
      原文只提到能源获取不平等危及生计，并未说电力系统是财富分配不均的primary
           cause；It is the primary cause of inequitable distribution of wealth添加了因果
      关系。

        D) 以偏概全
      Agok的电脑课取消只是个别例子，不能推出整个电力系统剥夺了众多非洲人使用电脑的
         机会；deprives many Africans of the opportunity to use computers以偏概全。

52. What do we learn from the passage about Africa's past electrification efforts?

   A) They have failed to meet most Africans' need of a reliable power supply.

   B) They have failed to build a national grid to provide electric power.

   C) They have unleashed the true economic potential of the continent.

我们从文章中了解到非洲过去的电气化努力有什么情况?
A) 它们未能满足大多数非洲人对可靠电力供应的需求。  B) 它们未能建立提供电力的国家电网。

C) 它们释放了该大陆真正的经济潜力。  D) 它们旨在用清洁、可靠的能源为非洲布线。
【答案】A （细节题）

【判型】What do we learn from the passage about Africa's past electrification efforts?要求从
    文中提取关于过去电气化努力的事实。

【拆句】What do we learn from the passage about Africa's past electrification efforts?主干为
       What do we learn，from the passage about...引出信息来源与对象；past限定时间范
      围，需与文中historically对应。

【定位】Historically, national governments on the continent have led electrification efforts, but fewer
         than half of the people surveyed say that the national grid is providing a reliable supply
          of electricity.

    历史上，非洲大陆各国政府主导了电气化工作，但受访人群中不到一半的人表示国家电网提
    供了可靠的电力供应。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确

             fewer than half of the people surveyed say that the national grid is providing a reliable supply of
                electricity

             Africans' need of a reliable power supply一致。

        B) 与原文相反
       原文说国家电网存在但不可靠，failed to build a national grid却说没建成电网，与原

        C) 张冠李戴/时间错位
      释放非洲经济潜力是作者在P2提出的未来愿景，不是过去电气化努力的结果。

        essential，to tackling...为介词短语说明对象；全句为简单疑问句，无生僻语法。

         temporary solutions with reliable and affordable alternatives.

A) 有大笔资金可赚。  B) 它们有足够的资金到位。  C) 南非树立了成功的榜样。

        Saharan Africa?询问动机，需要由原文事实做一步逻辑延伸，而非直接找到原句。

        Saharan Africa?主干为Why will private companies be motivated，to join...为不定式短

真题卷第3套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part IV


Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English.
You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.

   近年来，中国无人机(drone) 产业蓬勃发展，出口量跃升为全球第一。中国的无人机以出色的稳
定性、高清 (high-definition)拍摄能力和便捷的操作，受到全球消费者的喜爱，在民用领域得到广泛应
用。无人机已被国家纳入战略性新兴产业，逐步成为能满足多种场景需求的智能助手。在农村，无人
机可精准识别农作物病虫害，高效喷洒农药。在城市，无人机可快速运送生鲜食品。在不久的将来，

text:
【衔接】第4、5句之间：复刻对仗句式

     在农村，无人机可精准识别农作物病虫害，高效喷洒农药。在城市，无人机可快速运送生鲜食品。
     两句是原文设计的平行结构，英文用 In rural areas, drones can... / In cities, drones can... 同槽
     位对齐，中间不需任何关联词，对仗本身就是衔接。

     第5、6句之间：时间词自然推进
     从当下应用讲到在不久的将来的前景，句首 In the near future 自带时间推进信号，承接上文无需
     再加 however / moreover；主语沿用 drones，与全篇保持一致，读者视线不断。

     第2、3句之间：主语由 Chinese drones 收敛为 drones

     第2句主语已用 Chinese drones 完整出现，第3句起无人机直接承续译 drones 即可，不必每句都
     重复 Chinese——专名在首句锁定、后文用简式，是避免整篇累赘的基本手法。


逐句解析
一整段连排中文、无段落标记无题号——把它切成一句句翻译单元本身就是解题动作，句前 N. 为逐句解析自切的
句序号（非考卷题号），与卷面中文逐字对应。

【主旨】中国无人机产业现状与前景的客观介绍

      全段围绕中国无人机(drone) 产业蓬勃发展展开，依次讲出口地位、产品优点、政策定位、农村与
     城市应用、未来价值，是典型的六级汉译英高频语体——社会发展类客观介绍，用词宜正式、平
     实、信息密集，不带个人情感。

【时态】一般现在时

     全篇主体是在陈述当前事实与普遍能力，如受到全球消费者的喜爱，在民用领域得到广泛应用和无
     人机可精准识别农作物病虫害，属客观介绍，故默认用一般现在时；仅在三处有据偏离：近年来引
     出的已发生动作用现在完成时，已被国家纳入的"已"字用现在完成时被动，在不久的将来用一般将
     来时。

【译法】中国无人机产业
       中国无人机(drone) 产业统一译作 China's drone industry。drone 一词原文已给出，直接沿
      用；"产业"译 industry，全篇不再换成 business / sector，避免一词两译。

    战略性新兴产业
     战略性新兴产业是政策固定表述，约定俗成译法为 strategic emerging industries；industries 用
     复数，因为它指一类产业的集合，不要自造 new strategic industries 之类的译名。

    民用领域

     民用领域统一译 civilian fields（或 the civilian sector），与 military 相对用 civilian；不要在同
     篇一会儿 civil 一会儿 civilian。

    农作物病虫害

     农作物病虫害是"病害+虫害"的合称，意译为 crop diseases and pests，两个名词都用复数表泛
     指；不要硬译成 disease insects。

    新动能
     注入新动能的"新动能"译 new momentum（不可数）或 new driving force，全篇取 new
       momentum 一种即可；"注入"搭配 inject...into...，比 give 更正式贴合语体。
